"‏صِنفان من أهل النار لم أرهما‏:‏ قوم معهم سياط كأذناب البقر يضربون بها الناس، ونساء كاسيات عاريات مميلات مائلات، رءوسهن كأسنمة البخت المائلة لا يدخلن الجنة، ولا يجدن ريحها، وإن ريحها ليوجد من مسيرة كذا وكذا‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ معنى ((كاسيات)) اي من نعمة الله ((عاريات)) من شكرها ، وقيل معناه: تستر بعض بدنها ، وتكشف بعضه إظهارا بحالها ونحوه ، وقيل : معناه تلبس ثوبا رقيقا يصف لون بدنها .
وأما ( مائلات ) فقيل : معناه عن طاعة الله ، وما يلزمهن حفظه . ( مميلات ) أي يعلمن غيرهن فعلهن المذموم ، وقيل : مائلات يمشين متبخترات ، مميلات لأكتافهن . وقيل : مائلات يمشطن المشطة المائلة ، وهي مشطة البغايا . مميلات يمشطن غيرهن تلك المشطة . ومعنى ( رءوسهن كأسنمة البخت ) أن يكبرنها ويعظمنها بلف عمامة أو عصابة أو نحوهما .
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There are two types of people who will be punished in Hell and whom I have not seen: men having whips like the tails of cows and they will be beating people with them, and, women who will be dressed but appear to be naked, inviting to evil; and they themselves will be inclined to it. Their heads will appear like the humps of the Bactrian camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Jannah and they will not smell its fragrance which is perceptible from such and such a distance.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: There are two types of people who will be punished in Hell and whom I have not seen: men having whips like the tails of cows and they will be beating people with them, and, women who will be dressed but appear to be naked, inviting to evil; and they themselves will be inclined to it. Their heads will appear like the humps of the Bactrian camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Jannah and they will not smell its fragrance which is perceptible from such and such a distance.

hadiths.arabic:
عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا تأكلوا بالشمال، فإن الشيطان يأكل ويشرب بشماله‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: "Do not eat with your left hand, because Satan eats and drinks with his left hand.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Do not eat with your left hand, because Satan eats and drinks with his left hand.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا يأكلن أحدكم بشماله، ولا يشربن بها‏.‏ فإن الشيطان يأكل بشماله ويشرب بها‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No person should eat and drink with his left hand for Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: No person should eat and drink with his left hand for Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏إن اليهود والنصارى لا يصبغون، فخالفوهم‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏ ‏.‏ المُرَادُ: خِضَابُ شَعْرِ اللِّحْيةِ والرَّأسِ الأبْيضِ بِصُفْرةٍ أوْ حُمْرةٍ، وأمَّا السَّوادُ، فَمنْهيُّ عَنْهُ كَما سَنَذْكُرُ في الْباب بعْدَهُ، إنْ شَاءَ اللَّه تَعَالَى.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: "Jews and Christians do not dye their hair, so act differently from them.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Jews and Christians do not dye their hair, so act differently from them.

hadiths.arabic:
عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ أتي بأبي قحافة والد أبي بكر الصديق رضي الله عنهما يوم فتح مكة ورأسه ولحيته كالثغامة بياضًا، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏غيروا هذا واجتنبوا السواد‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: Abu Quhafah, father of Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with them) was presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the conquest of Makkah and his head and beard were snow white. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Change it (i.e., dye it and avoid black colour).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Change it (i.e., dye it and avoid black colour).

hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن القزع‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade shaving a part of the head..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade shaving a part of the head..

hadiths.arabic:
وعنه قال‏:‏ رأى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  صبيًا قد حلق بعض شعر رأسه وترك بعضه فنهاهم عن ذلك وقال‏:‏ ‏
"‏احلقوه كله، أو اتركوه كله‏"‏‏.‏ رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح على شرط البخاري ومسلم‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a boy, some portion of whose head was shaved and some of it was left out. He prohibited them from that and said, "Shave the whole of it or leave the whole of it.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Shave the whole of it or leave the whole of it.

hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن جعفر رضي الله عنهما أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  أمهل آل جعفر رضي الله عنه ثلاثًا، ثم أتاهم فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏لا تبكوا على أخي بعد اليوم‏"‏‏.‏ ثم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏ادعوا لي بني أخي‏"‏ فجيء بنا كأننا أفرخ فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏ادعوا لي الحلاق‏"‏ فأمره، فحلق رءوسنا‏"‏‏.‏ رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح على شرط البخاري ومسلم‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Ja'far (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave respite for three days to the family of Ja'far (after his martydom). Then he came and said, "Don't weep for my brother after this day." He said, "Bring all of my nephews to me." We were accordingly brought as if we were chickens. Then he said, "Call for me a barber." He directed him to shave our heads which he did..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Don't weep for my brother after this day.

hadiths.arabic: وعن علي قال‏:‏ نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن تحلق المرأة رأسها‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه النسائي‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited a woman from shaving her head..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited a woman from shaving her head..

hadiths.arabic:
وعَنْ أسْمَاءَ رَضِيَ اللَّه عنْهَا: أنَّ امْرأَةً سألتِ النبيَّ ﷺ فَقَالتْ: يا رَسُولَ اللَّه، إنَّ ابْنَتِي أصَابَتْهَا الْحَصْبةُ، فتَمَرَّقَ شَعْرُهَا، وإنِّي زَوَّجْتُها، أفَأَصِلُ فِيهِ؟ فقالَ: لَعَنَ اللَّه الْواصِلةَ والْمَوصولة متفقٌ عليه.
وفي روايةٍ: الواصِلَةَ والمُسْتوصِلَةَ. قَوْلَهَا:"فَتَمرَّقَ"هو بالرَّاءِ، ومعناهُ: انْتثر وَسَقَطَ،"والْوَاصِلة": التي تَصِلُ شَعْرهَا، أو شَعْر غَيْرِهَا بشَعْرٍ آخَرَ."والمَوْصُولة": التي يُوصَلُ شَعْرُهَا. "والمُستَوصِلَةُ": التي تَسْأَلُ منْ يَفْعَلُ ذلكَ لَهَا.
hadiths.narrator: Asma' (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah! I have a daughter who had an attack of small pox and her hair fell off. Now I want to celebrate her marriage. Can I get her a wig?" Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has cursed the maker and wearer of a wig.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: O Messenger of Allah! I have a daughter who had an attack of small pox and her hair fell off. Now I want to celebrate her marriage. Can I get her a wig?

hadiths.arabic: وعَنْ عائشة رضي اللَّه عنْهَا نَحْوُهُ، متفقٌ عليه.
hadiths.text: A similar narration was narrated on the authority of 'Aishah.
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: A similar narration was narrated on the authority of 'Aishah.

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْ حميْدِ بن عبْدِ الرَّحْمن أنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعاويَةَ رضي اللَّه عنْهُ عامَ حجَّ علَى المِنْبَر وَتَنَاول قُصَّةً مِنْ شَعْرٍ كَانَتْ في يَدِ حَرِسيٍّ فَقَالَ: يَا أهْل المَدِينَةِ أيْنَ عُلَمَاؤكُمْ؟، سمِعْتُ النبيَّ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وسَلَّم يَنْهَى عنْ مِثْلِ هَذِهِ ويقُولُ: 
"إنًَّمَا هَلَكَتْ بنُو إسْرَائِيل حِينَ اتخذ هذه نِسَاؤُهُمْ" متفقٌ عليه.
hadiths.narrator: Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman (May Allah be pleased wth him) said:
hadiths.text: I saw Mu'awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) during the Hajj (pilgrimage) standing on the pulpit. He took from the guard a bunch of hair, and said: "O people of Al-Madinah! Where are your scholars? (Why do they do not prohibit you) I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibiting from using this (false hair) and saying, 'The people of Bani Israel were ruined when their women wore such hair."'
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: O people of Al-Madinah! Where are your scholars? (Why do they do not prohibit you) I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibiting from using this (false hair) and saying, 'The people of Bani Israel were ruined when their women wore such hair.

hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  لعن الواصلة والمستوصلة والواشمة والمستوشمة ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the maker and wearer of a wig and the tattooer and the one who is tattooed..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the maker and wearer of a wig and the tattooer and the one who is tattooed..

hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ لعن الله الواشمات والمستوشمات والمتنمصات والمتفلجات بالحسن، المغيرات خلق الله‏!‏ فقالت له امرأة في ذلك فقال‏:‏ وما لي لا ألعن من لعنه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو في كتاب الله‏؟‏‏!‏ قال الله تعالى‏:‏ ‏{‏وما آتاكم الرسول فخذوه وما نهاكم عنه فانتهوا‏}‏ ‏(‏‏(‏الحشر‏:‏7‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏  المتفلجة هي: التي تبرد من أسنانها ليتباعد بعضها من بعض قليلا، وتحسنها وهو الوشر. والنامصة:  التي تأخذ من شعر حاجب غيرها، وترققه ليصير حسنا. والمتنمصة: التي تأمر من يفعل بها ذلك.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those women who have themselves tattooed, and those women who get their hair removed from their eyebrows and faces (except the beard and the mustache), and those who make artificial spaces between their teeth for beauty, whereby they change Allah's creation. A woman started to argue with him, saying: "What is all this?" He replied: "Why should I not curse those whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed and who are cursed in Allah's Book? Allah, the Exalted, has said in His Book:"And whatsoever the Messenger (Muhammad (ﷺ)) gives you, take it; and whatsoever he forbids you, abstain (from it)." (59:7).
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: And whatsoever the Messenger (Muhammad (ﷺ)) gives you, take it; and whatsoever he forbids you, abstain (from it).

hadiths.arabic:
وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏من عمل عملا ليس عليه أمرنا فهو رد‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who does something contrary to our way (i.e., Islam) will have it rejected.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who does something contrary to our way (i.e., Islam) will have it rejected.

hadiths.arabic:
عن أبي قتادة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏إذا بال أحدكم، فلا يؤخذن ذكره بيمينه، ولا يستنجي بيمينه، ولا يتنفس في الإناء‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏ وفي الباب أحاديث كثيرة صحيحة‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not touch your private parts with your right hand while urinating, nor for washing or cleaning (your private parts); and do not breathe into the drinking vessel from which you drink.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Do not touch your private parts with your right hand while urinating, nor for washing or cleaning (your private parts); and do not breathe into the drinking vessel from which you drink.

hadiths.arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏"‏لا يمشي أحدكم في نعل واحدة لينعلهما جميعًا او ليخلعهما جميعًا‏"‏‏.‏  
وفي رواية ‏"‏ أو ليحفهما جميعًا ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "None of you should walk wearing one shoe; you should either wear them both or take them off both.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: None of you should walk wearing one shoe; you should either wear them both or take them off both.

hadiths.arabic:
وعنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏إذا انقطع شسع نعل أحدكم، فلا يمشِ في الأخرى حتى يصلحها‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "When the lace of one of the shoes of any one of you is cut off, he should not walk with the other until he has got the lace repaired.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: When the lace of one of the shoes of any one of you is cut off, he should not walk with the other until he has got the lace repaired.

hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى أن ينتعل الرجل قائمًا‏"‏‏.‏ ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن ))
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade a person wearing (tying up) his shoe while standing..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade a person wearing (tying up) his shoe while standing..

hadiths.arabic:
عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا تتركوا النار في بيوتكم حين تنامون‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not keep the fire burning in your homes when you go to bed.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Do not keep the fire burning in your homes when you go to bed.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي موسى الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ احترق بيت بالمدينة على أهله من الليل، فلما حدث رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  بشأنهم قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏إن هذه النار عدو لكم، فإذا نمتم فأطفئوها‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: A house in Al-Madinah was burnt with its occupants inside it one night. When this was reported to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he said, "Fire is your enemy. So, put it out before going to bed.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Fire is your enemy. So, put it out before going to bed.

hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏"‏غطوا الإناء، وأوكئوا السقاء، وأغلقوا الأبواب، وأطفئوا السراج، فإن الشيطان لا يحل سقاء، ولايفتح بابًا ولايكشف إناءً، إن لم يجد أحدكم إلا أن يعرض على إنائه عودا، ويذكر اسم الله، فليفعل، فإن الفويسقة تضرم على أهل البيت بيتهم‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏ ‏"‏الفويسقة‏:‏ الفأرة، و‏"‏تضرم‏"‏‏:‏ تحرق‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Cover up the (kitchen) containers (i.e., pots, pans, etc.), tie up the mouth of the water-skin, lock up the doors and extinguish the lamps, because Satan can neither untie the water-skin nor open the door nor uncover the containers. If one can cover the cooking pot even by placing a piece of wood across it, and pronounce the Name of Allah on it, let him do it. A mouse can sometimes cause a house to burn along its dwellers."
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Cover up the (kitchen) containers (i.e., pots, pans, etc.), tie up the mouth of the water-skin, lock up the doors and extinguish the lamps, because Satan can neither untie the water-skin nor open the door nor uncover the containers. If one can cover the cooking pot even by placing a piece of wood across it, and pronounce the Name of Allah on it, let him do it. A mouse can sometimes cause a house to burn along its dwellers.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال ‏:‏‏
"‏نهينا عن التكلف‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: We have been forbidden to go into excess..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: We have been forbidden to go into excess..

hadiths.arabic: وعن مسروق قال ‏:‏ دخلنا على عبدالله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه فقال ‏:‏ يا أيها الناس من علم شيئا فليقل به، ومن لم يعلم، فليقل ‏:‏الله أعلم، فإن من العلم أن يقول الرجل لما لا يعلم‏:‏ الله أعلم ‏.‏ قال الله تعالى لنبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏‏{‏قل ما أسألكم عليه من أجر وما أنا من المتكلفين‏}‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Masruq (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: We visited 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) and he said to us: O people! He who has the knowledge of any matter may convey it to the others. And he who has no knowledge, thereof, should say: "Allahu a'lam (Allah knows better)." It is a part and parcel of knowledge that a man who has no knowledge of a matter should say: "Allah knows better." Allah said to His Prophet (ﷺ):"Say (O Muhammad (ﷺ)): 'No wage do I ask of you for this (the Qur'an), nor am I one of the Mutakallifun (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist)."' (38:86).
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Allahu a'lam (Allah knows better).

hadiths.arabic: عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏:‏‏"‏الميت يُعذب في قبره بما نِيح عليه ‏"‏‏. وَفِي روايةٍ:"مَا نِيحَ علَيْهِ"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The deceased is tortured in his grave for bewailing over him.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The deceased is tortured in his grave for bewailing over him.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏:‏‏
"‏ليس منا من ضرب الخدود، وشق الجيوب، ودعا بدعوى الجاهليه‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who (on befalling a calamity) slaps his cheeks, tears his clothes and follows the ways and traditions of the Days of Ignorance is none of us.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who (on befalling a calamity) slaps his cheeks, tears his clothes and follows the ways and traditions of the Days of Ignorance is none of us.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي بردة قال‏:‏ وجع أبو موسى، فغشي عليه، ورأسه في حجر امرأة من أهله، فأقبلت تصيح برنة فلم يستطع أن يرد عليها شيئًا، فلما أفاق ،قال ‏:‏ أنا بريء ممن برئ منه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  برئ من الصالقة، والحالقة، والشاقة‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏ ‏
"‏الصالقة‏"‏‏:‏ التي ترفع صوتها بالنياحة والندب‏.‏ ‏
والحالقة‏ ‏‏:‏ التي تحلق رأسها عند المصيبة‏ ‏ الشاقة ‏ ‏‏:‏التي تشق ثوبها‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Burdah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.text: (My father) Abu Musa got seriously ill and lost his consciousness. His head was in the lap of a woman of the family and she began to wail. When Abu Musa recovered his consciousness, he said: "I am innocent of those from whom Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is innocent. Verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) declared himself free of (the responsibility) for a woman who wails, shaves her head and tears up her clothes.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: I am innocent of those from whom Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is innocent. Verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) declared himself free of (the responsibility) for a woman who wails, shaves her head and tears up her clothes.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن المغيرة بن شعبة رضي الله عنه قال ‏:‏سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏
"‏من نِيح عليه، فإنه يُعذب بما نِيح عليه يوم القيامة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "He who allows (others) to wail over his death, will be punished for it on the Day of Resurrection.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who allows (others) to wail over his death, will be punished for it on the Day of Resurrection.

hadiths.arabic: وعن أم عطية نَُسيبة -بضم النون وفتحها- رضي الله عنها قالت ‏:‏ أخذ علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  عند البيعة أن لا ننوح‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Umm 'Atiyyah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: At the time of giving the pledge of allegiance, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took from us an oath that we would not wail..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: At the time of giving the pledge of allegiance, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took from us an oath that we would not wail..

hadiths.arabic: وعن النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ أغمي على عبد الله بن رواحة رضي الله عنه فجعلت أخته تبكي، وتقول‏:‏ واجبلاه، وا كذا وا كذا‏:‏ تعدد عليه  فقال حين أفاق‏:‏ ما قلت شيئًا ألا قيل لي ‏:‏أنت كذلك‏؟‏‏!‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, his sister began to weep and shout: "Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! for such and such (mentioning his virtuous qualities)." When he recovered his consciousness, he said: "I was asked (disapprovingly, by the angels) about everything you said concerning me whether I am as you said.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! for such and such (mentioning his virtuous qualities).

hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ اشتكى سعد بن عبادة رضي الله عنه شكوى فأتاه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يعوده مع عبد الرحمن بن عوف، وسعد بن أبي وقاص، وعبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنهم، فلما دخل عليه، وجده في غشية فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏أقضي‏؟‏‏"‏ قالوا‏:‏ لا يا رسول الله فبكى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  فلما رأى القوم بكاء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  بكوا، قال‏:‏ ‏"‏ألا تسمعون‏؟‏ إن الله لا يُعذب بدمع العين، ولا بحزن القلب، ولكن يعذب بهذا‏"‏ وأشار إلى لسانه ‏"‏أو يرحم‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). When they entered his house, they found him unconscious. The Messenger of Allah asked, "Has he died?" They replied: "No, O Messenger of Allah." Hearing this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to weep. When his Companions saw this, they also began to weep too. He said, "Listen attentively: Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but takes to task or show mercy because of the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Has he died?

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي مالك الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏النائحة إذا لم تتب قبل موتها تقام يوم القيامة وعليها سربال من قطران، ودرع من جرب‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a garment of scabies (Allah knows the nature thereof).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a garment of scabies (Allah knows the nature thereof).

hadiths.arabic: وعن أسيد بن أبي أسيد التابعي عن امرأة من المبايعات قالت‏:‏ كان فيما أخذ علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، في المعروف الذي أخذ علينا أن لا نعصيه فيه‏:‏ أن لا نخمش وجهًا، ولا ندعو ويلا، ولا نشق جيبًا، وأن لا ننشر شعرًا‏"‏‏. ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن  ))‏
hadiths.narrator: Asid bin Abu Usaid reported:
hadiths.text: A woman who had taken a pledge of allegiance at the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Among the matters in respect of which we gave the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the pledge not to disobey him in any Ma'ruf .
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: A woman who had taken a pledge of allegiance at the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Among the matters in respect of which we gave the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the pledge not to disobey him in any Ma'ruf .

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏ما من ميت يموت، فيقوم باكيهم، فيقول‏:‏ واجبلاه، وأسيداه، أو نحو ذلك إلا وكل به ملكان يلهزانه‏:‏ أهكذا كنت‏؟‏‏!‏‏"‏‏.‏ رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن‏.‏
«اللَّهْزُ»: الدَّفْعُ بِجُمْعِ اليَدِ فِي الصَّدْرِ.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ...' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' ".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ...' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?'

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏اثنان في الناس هما بهم كفر‏:‏ الطعن في النسب، والنياحة على الميت‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Slandering one's lineage and wailing over the dead.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Slandering one's lineage and wailing over the dead.

hadiths.arabic:
عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  أناس عن الكهان، فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏ليسوا بشيء‏"‏ فقالوا‏:‏ يا رسول الله إنهم يحدثونا أحيانًا بشيء، فيكون حقًا‏؟‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏تلك الكلمة من الحق يخطفها الجني‏.‏ فيقرها في أذن وليه، فيخلطون معها مائة كذبة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏  
وفي رواية للبخاري عن عائشة رضي الله عنها أنها سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏إن الملائكة تنزل في العَنان -وهو السحاب-‏.‏ فتذكر الأمر قضي في السماء، فيسترق الشيطان السمع، فيسمعه، فيوحيه إلى الكهان، فيكذبون معها مائة كذبة من عند أنفسهم‏"‏‏ 
قَولُهُ: «فَيَقُرُّهَا» هو بفتح الياء وضم القاف والراء، أي: يُلْقِيها، «والعَنانِ» بفتح العين.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: Some people asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about soothsayers. He (ﷺ) said, "They are of no account." Upon this they said to him, "O Messenger of Allah! But they sometimes make true predictions." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches (from the angels) and whispers into the ears of his friend (the soothsayers) who will then mix more than a hundred lies with it.".The narration in Al-Bukhari is: "The angels descend in the clouds and mention matters which has been decreed in heaven; Satan steals a hearing (listens to it stealthily) and communicates it to the soothsayers who tell along with it a hundred lies."
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: They are of no account.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن قبيصة بنت أبي عبيد، عن بعض أزواج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، ورضي الله عنها، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏من أتي عرافًا فسأله عن شيء، فصدقه، لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين يومًا‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.text: Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "He who goes to one who claims to tell about matters of the Unseen and believes in him, his Salat (prayers) will not be accepted for forty days.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who goes to one who claims to tell about matters of the Unseen and believes in him, his Salat (prayers) will not be accepted for forty days.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن قبيصة بن المخارق رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏العِيافة، والطِّيَرة، والطرق، من الجبت‏"‏‏.‏ ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).
وقال: «الطَّرْقُ» هُوَ الزَّجْرُ: أيْ زَجْرُ الطَّيْرِ وَهُوَ أنْ يَتَيَمَّنَ أو يَتَشَاءمَ بِطَيَرَانِهِ، فإنْ طَارَ إلَى جِهَةِ اليَمِين، تَيَمَّنَ، وإنْ طَارَ إلَى جِهَةِ اليَسَارِ، تَشَاءمَ. قال أبو داود: «والعِيَافَةُ»: الخَطُّ.
قالَ الجَوْهَريُّ في الصِّحَاحِ: الجِبْتُ كَلِمَةٌ تَقَعُ عَلَى الصَّنَمِ وَالكاهِنِ والسَّاحِرِ وَنَحْوِ ذلِكَ.
hadiths.narrator: Qabisah bin Al-Mukhariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The practice of 'Iyafah, the interpretation of omens from the flight of birds, the practice of divination by drawing lines on the ground and taking evil omens are all practices of Al-Jibt (the idol, the diviner, or sorcerer).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The practice of 'Iyafah, the interpretation of omens from the flight of birds, the practice of divination by drawing lines on the ground and taking evil omens are all practices of Al-Jibt (the idol, the diviner, or sorcerer).

hadiths.arabic:
وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏من اقتبس علمًا من النجوم، اقتبس شعبة من السحر زاد ما زاد‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who acquires a branch of the knowledge of astrology, learns a branch of magic (of which he acquires more as long as) he continues to do so.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who acquires a branch of the knowledge of astrology, learns a branch of magic (of which he acquires more as long as) he continues to do so.

hadiths.arabic: وعن معاوية بن الحكم رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قلت يا رسول الله إني حديث عهد بجاهلية، وقد جاء الله تعالى بالإسلام، وإن منا رجالا يأتون الكهان‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏فلا تأتهم‏"‏ قلت‏:‏ ومنا رجال يتطيرون‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏ذلك شيء يجدونه في صدورهم، فلا يصدهم‏"‏ قلت‏:‏ ومنا رجال يخطون‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏كان نبي من الأنبياء يخط، فمن وافق خطه، فذاك‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.text: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah has favoured me with Islam. There are still some men among us who visit the soothsayers to consult them (on matters relating to the future)." He (ﷺ) replied, "Do not visit them." I said: "There are some men who are guided by omens." He replied, "These are the ideas which come up in their minds but you should not be influenced by them (i.e., these things) should not prevent them from pursuing their works." I said: "There are some men who practise divination by drawing lines on the ground." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "There was a Prophet who drew lines, the line which agrees with the line drawn by that Prophet would be correct.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: There was a Prophet who drew lines, the line which agrees with the line drawn by that Prophet would be correct.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي مسعود البدري رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏
"‏نهى عن ثمن الكلب، ومهر البغي وحُلوان الكاهن‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited the price of a dog, the earning of an prostitute, and the money given to a soothsayer..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited the price of a dog, the earning of an prostitute, and the money given to a soothsayer..

hadiths.arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏لا عدوى ولا طِيَرة ويعجبني الفأل‏"‏ قالوا‏:‏ وما الفأل‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏كلمة طيبة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I am pleased with good omens." He was asked: "What is good omen?" He replied, "A good word.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I am pleased with good omens.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا عدوى ولا طِيَرة، وإن كان الشؤم في شيء ففي الدار والمرأة، والفرس‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There is no infection and no evil omen; but if there is anything (that may be a source of trouble) then it could be a house, a horse, and a woman.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: There is no infection and no evil omen; but if there is anything (that may be a source of trouble) then it could be a house, a horse, and a woman.

hadiths.arabic: وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  كان لا يتطير‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet never took ill omens..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Prophet never took ill omens..

hadiths.arabic:
وعن عروة بن عامر رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ ذكرت الطِيَرة عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال‏:‏ ‏
"‏أحسنها الفأل، ولا ترد مسلمًا فإذا رأى أحدكم ما يكره، فليقل‏:‏ اللهم لا يأتي بالحسنات إلا أنت، ولا يدفع السيئات إلا أنت، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بك‏"‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Urwah bin 'Amir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: When talking of omens was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he said, "The best type of omen is the good omen." He added, "A Muslim should not refrain from anything because of an omen." He (ﷺ) told them, "When any of you sees anything which he dislikes, he should say: 'Allahuma la ya'ti bil-hasanati illa Anta, wa la yadfa'us- sayyi'ati illa Anta, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Bika (O Allah ! You Alone bring good things; You Alone avert evil things, and there is no might or power but in You)."'.
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The best type of omen is the good omen.

hadiths.arabic:
عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏إن الذين يصنعون هذه الصور يعذبون يوم القيامة، يقال لهم‏:‏ أحيوا ما خلقتم‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Those who draw pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection; and it will be said to them: 'Breathe soul into what you have created."'.
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Those who draw pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection; and it will be said to them: 'Breathe soul into what you have created.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ قدم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  من سفر وقد سترت سهوة لي بقرام فيه تماثيل فلما رآه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، تلون وجهه، وقال‏:‏ ‏
"‏يا عائشة، أشد الناس عذابًا عن الله يوم القيامة الذين يضاهون بخلق الله‏"‏ قالت‏:‏ فقطعناه، فجعلنا منه وسادة أو وسادتين‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ «القِرامُ» بكسرِ القاف هو: السِّتْرُ. «وَالسَّهْوَةُ» بفتح السينِ المهملة وهي: الصُّفَّةُ تَكُونُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ البَيْتِ، وقيلَ: هِيَ الطَّاقُ النَّافِذُ في الحائِطِ.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hanging over it and on which there were portraits. When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation.

hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏كل مصور في النار يجعل له بكل صورة صورها نفس فيعذبه في جهنم‏"‏ قال ابن عباس‏:‏ فإن كنت لابد فاعلا، فاصنع الشجر وما لا ورح فيه‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Every painter will go to Hell, and for every portrait he has made, there will be appointed one who will chastise him in the Hell." Ibn 'Abbas said: If you have to do it, draw pictures of trees and other inanimate things..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Every painter will go to Hell, and for every portrait he has made, there will be appointed one who will chastise him in the Hell.

hadiths.arabic:
وعنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏من صور في الدنيا، كُلف أن يَنفخ فيها الروح يوم القيامة وليس بنافخ‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Whosoever makes a picture, will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and will be asked to infuse soul therein, which he will not be able to do.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Whosoever makes a picture, will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and will be asked to infuse soul therein, which he will not be able to do.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏إن أشد الناس عذابًا يوم القيامة المصورون‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Those who will receive the most severe punishment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be painters (of living objects).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Those who will receive the most severe punishment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be painters (of living objects).

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏قال الله تعالى‏:‏ ‏{‏ومن أظلم ممن ذهب يخلق كخلقي‏!‏ فليخلقوا ذرة أو ليخلقوا حبة، أو ليخلقوا شعيرة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The Almighty Allah said: 'Who is more an oppressor than him who goes to create like My creation? Let him make an ant or a grain of corn or a grain of barley."'.
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Almighty Allah said: 'Who is more an oppressor than him who goes to create like My creation? Let him make an ant or a grain of corn or a grain of barley.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي طلحة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا تدخل الملائكة بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ وعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  جبريل أن يأتيه فراث عليه حتى اشتد على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، فخرج فلقيه جبريل فشكا إليه، فقال‏:‏ إنا لا ندخل بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏ ‏(‏‏(‏‏
"‏راث‏"‏‏:‏ أبطأ، وهو بالثاء المثلثة‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but delayed and this grieved him very much. When he came out of his house, Jibril met him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him about the reason of delay, and he replied: "We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait.

hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ واعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  جبريل عليه السلام في ساعة أن يأتيه، فجاءت تلك الساعة ولم يأته‏!‏ قالت‏:‏ وكان بيده عصًا، فطرحها من يده وهو يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏ما يخلف الله وعده ولا رسله‏"‏ ثم التفت، فإذا جرو كلب تحت سريره‏.‏ فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏متى دخل هذا الكلب‏؟‏‏"‏ فقلت‏:‏ والله ما دريت به، فأمر به فأخرج، فجاءه جبريل عليه السلام‏:‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏وعدتني، فجلست لك ولم تأتني‏"‏ فقال‏:‏ منعني الكلب الذي كان في بيتك، إنا لا ندخل بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: Jibril (Gabriel) (ﷺ) made a promise with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. There was a staff in the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He threw it from his hand and said, "Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers." Then he noticed a puppy under his bed and said, "O 'Aishah, when did this dog enter?" She said: "By Allah, I don't know." He then commanded that it should be turned out. No sooner than had they expelled it, Jibril came and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him, "You promised to visit me. I waited for you but you did not come." Whereupon he said: "The dog kept me from coming. We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers.

hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي الهياج حيان بن حصين قال‏:‏ قال لي علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه‏:‏ ألا أبعثك على ما بعثني عليه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏؟‏ أن لا تدع صورة إلا طمستها، ولا قبرًا مشرفًا إلا سويته‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abul-Haiyaj Haiyan bin Husain said:
hadiths.text: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Shall I not send you to do a task that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had assigned to me? Spare no portrait unwiped out, and leave not a high grave unlevelled.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Shall I not send you to do a task that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had assigned to me? Spare no portrait unwiped out, and leave not a high grave unlevelled.

hadiths.arabic:
عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏من اقتنى كلبًا إلا كلب صيد أو ماشية فإنه ينقص فإنه ينقص من أجره كل يوم قيراطان‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ 
وفي رواية‏:‏ ‏ ‏قيراط‏‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding the fields or herds or hunting, will lose two Qirat every day out of his rewards.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding the fields or herds or hunting, will lose two Qirat every day out of his rewards.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏من أمسك كلبًا فإنه ينقص كل يوم من عمله قيراط إلا كلب حرث أو ماشية‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏  
وفي رواية لمسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏من اقتنى كلبًا ليس بكلب صيد، ولا ماشية ولا أرض، فإنه ينقص من أجره قيراطان كل يوم‏"‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good deeds equal to one Qirat every day, except one who keeps it for guarding the fields or the herd.".In a narration of Muslim, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is reported to have said: "He who keeps a dog for any reason other than to guard his property (lands) or his flock of sheep, his good deeds equal to two Qirat will be deducted every day."
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good deeds equal to one Qirat every day, except one who keeps it for guarding the fields or the herd.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا تصحب الملائكة رفقة كلب أو جرس‏"‏‏.‏ ((رواه مسلم))
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog or a bell.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog or a bell.

hadiths.arabic:
وعنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏الجرس مزامير الشيطان‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The bell is one of the musical instruments of Satan.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The bell is one of the musical instruments of Satan.

hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن الجلالة في الإبل أن يركب عليها‏.‏ ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح ))
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited riding a camel which eats dung, or animal or human waste..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited riding a camel which eats dung, or animal or human waste..

hadiths.arabic:
عن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏البصاق في المسجد خطيئة، وكفارتها دفنها‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏  والمرادُ بِدَفْنِهَا إذَا كَانَ المَسْجِدُ تُرَابًا أوْ رَمْلًا ونَحْوَهُ فَيُوَارِيهَا تَحْتَ تُرَابِهِ. قالَ أبُو المحاسِنِ الرُّويَانِي مِنْ أصحابِنا في كِتَابِهِ (البحر) وقِيلَ: المُرَادُ بِدَفْنِهَا إخْراجُهَا مِنَ المَسْجِدِ، أمَّا إِذَا كَانَ المَسْجِدُ مُبَلَّطًا أَوْ مُجَصَّصًا، فَدَلَكَهَا عَلَيْهِ بِمَدَاسِهِ أَوْ بِغَيْرِهِ كَمَا يَفْعَلُهُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ الجُهَّالِ، فَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِدَفْنٍ، بَلْ زِيَادَةٌ فِي الخَطِيئَةِ وَتَكْثِيرٌ لِلقَذَرِ في المَسْجِدِ، وَعَلَى مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ أنْ يَمْسَحَهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِثَوْبِهِ أَوْ بِيَدِهِ أَوْ غَيرِهِ أَوْ يَغْسِلَهُ.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that the spittle should be buried in earth.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that the spittle should be buried in earth.

hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رأى في جدار القبلة مخاطا أو بزاقا أو نخامة فحكه ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qiblah and scratched it off..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qiblah and scratched it off..

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏إن هذه المساجد لا تصلح لشيء من البول ولا القذر، إنما هي لذكر الله تعالى، وقراءة القرآن‏"‏ أو كما قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not proper to use the mosque for urinating or easing oneself. They are merely built for the remembrance of Allah and the recitation of the Qur'an", or as he stated..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: It is not proper to use the mosque for urinating or easing oneself. They are merely built for the remembrance of Allah and the recitation of the Qur'an

hadiths.arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏من سمع رجلا ينشد ضالة في المسجد فليقل‏:‏ لا ردها الله عليك، فإن المساجد لم تبنَ لهذا‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: 'La raddaha Allahu 'alaika (May Allah not restore it to you),' for mosques are not built for this purpose."
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: 'La raddaha Allahu 'alaika (May Allah not restore it to you),' for mosques are not built for this purpose.

hadiths.arabic:
وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏إذا رأيتم من يبيع أو يبتاع في المسجد، فقولوا‏:‏ لا أربح الله تجارتك، وإذا رأيتم من ينشد ضالة فقولوا‏:‏ لا ردها الله عليك‏"‏‏.‏ رواه الترمذي، وقال: (حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ).
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah said, "When you see someone buying or selling in the mosque, say to him: 'La arbaha-Allahu tijarataka (May Allah not make your bargain profitable)!' When you see someone announcing something lost in it, say: 'May Allah not restore it to you!"'.
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: When you see someone buying or selling in the mosque, say to him: 'La arbaha-Allahu tijarataka (May Allah not make your bargain profitable)!' When you see someone announcing something lost in it, say: 'May Allah not restore it to you!

hadiths.arabic:
وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن رجلا نشد في المسجد فقال‏:‏ من دعا إلى الجمل الأحمر، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا وجدت، إنما بنيت المساجد لم بنيت له‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Has any one seen my red camel?" Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant to be (i.e., prayer, remembrance of Allah, acquiring knowledge, etc.).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant to be (i.e., prayer, remembrance of Allah, acquiring knowledge, etc.).

hadiths.arabic: وعن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  نهى عن الشراء والبيع في المسجد، وأن تنشد فيه ضالة، أو ينشد فيه شعر‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال حديث حسن‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his grandfather (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited (us) from buying and selling in the mosque; (he also prohibited us from) making announcement in it about something lost and from reciting poems in it..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited (us) from buying and selling in the mosque; (he also prohibited us from) making announcement in it about something lost and from reciting poems in it..

hadiths.arabic: وعن السائب بن زيد الصحابي رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ كنت في المسجد فحصبني رجل، فنظرت فإذا عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه فقال‏:‏ اذهب فائتني بهذين، فجئته بهما، فقال‏:‏ من أين أنتما‏؟‏ فقالا‏:‏ من أهل الطائف، فقال‏:‏ لو كنتما من أهل البلد، لأوجعتكما، ترفعان أصواتكما في مسجد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏!‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I saw that it was 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, who said: "Go and call me these two men." I brought them and 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) asked them: "Where are you from?" On their replying that they belonged to At-Taif, he said: "Had you been the inhabitants of Al-Madinah, I would have given you a beating for raising your voices in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: I brought them and 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) asked them:

hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏"‏من أكل من هذه الشجرة -يعني الثوم- فلا يقربن مسجدنا‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ وفي رواية لمسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏مساجدنا‏"‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosque.".The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosques."
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosque.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏من أكل من هذه الشجرة، فلا يقربنا، ولا يصلين معنا‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten from this plant (i.e., garlic) should not approach us and should not offer Salat (prayer) along with us.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who has eaten from this plant (i.e., garlic) should not approach us and should not offer Salat (prayer) along with us.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏من أكل ثومًا أو بصلا فليعتزلنا، أو فليعتزل مسجدنا‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏  
وفي رواية لمسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏من أكل البصل، والثوم، الكراث، فلا يقربن مسجدنا، فإن الملائكة تتأذى مما يتأذى منه بنو آدم‏"‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques.

hadiths.arabic: وعن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه أنه خطب يوم الجمعة فقال في خطبته‏:‏ ثم إنكم أيها الناس تأكلون شجرتين ما أراهما إلا خبيثتين‏:‏ البصل، والثوم -لقد رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا وجد ريحهما من الرجل في المسجد أمر به، فأخرج إلى البقيع، فمن أكلهما، فليمتهما طبخًا‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said in the sermon of Friday prayer:
hadiths.text: "O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odour of these to be very offensive. I saw that if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to find a man with such offensive odour in the mosque, he would order him to be taken out of the mosque and sent to Al-Baqi'. He who wants to eat any of these, should cook them till their odour dies out..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: "O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odour of these to be very offensive. I saw that if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to find a man with such offensive odour in the mosque, he would order him to be taken out of the mosque and sent to Al-Baqi'. He who wants to eat any of these, should cook them till their odour dies out..

hadiths.arabic: عن معاذ بن أنس الجهني، رضي الله عنه، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى عن الحبوة يوم الجمعة والإمام يخطب ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقالا‏:‏ حديث حسن‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade (us) from sitting with our legs drawn up to our belly (Ihtiba') during the Friday Khutbah (religious talk before the prayer)..
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade (us) from sitting with our legs drawn up to our belly (Ihtiba') during the Friday Khutbah (religious talk before the prayer)..

hadiths.arabic:
عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏من كان له ذبح يذبحه، فإذا أهل هلال ذي الحجة، فلا  يأخذن من شعره ولا من أظفاره شيئًا حتى يضحي‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the animal and enter in the month of Dhul-Hijjah, he should not get his hair cut or nails pared till he has offered his sacrifice.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the animal and enter in the month of Dhul-Hijjah, he should not get his hair cut or nails pared till he has offered his sacrifice.

hadiths.arabic:
عن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال‏:‏ ‏"‏إن الله تعالى ينهاكم أن تحلفوا بآبائكم، فمن كان حالفًا، فليحلف بالله، أو ليصمت‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏  
وفي رواية في الصحيح ‏"‏فمن كان حالفًا فلا يحلف إلا بالله أو ليسكت‏"‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oath, may do so by swearing in the Name of Allah or he should remain silent.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oath, may do so by swearing in the Name of Allah or he should remain silent.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن عبد الرحمن بن سَمُرَة، رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏لا تحلفوا بالطواغي، ولا بآبائكم‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ 
‏"‏الطواغي‏"‏‏:‏ جمع طاغية، وهي الأصنام، ومنه الحديث‏:‏ ‏"‏هذه طاغية دوس‏"‏‏:‏ أي‏:‏ صنمهم ومعبودهم، وروي في غير مسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏بالطواغيت‏"‏ جمع طاغوت، وهو الشيطان والصنم‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, false leaders, etc.) nor by your fathers.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, false leaders, etc.) nor by your fathers.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏من حلف بالأمانة، فليس منا‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who swears by Amanah (trust) is not one of us.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who swears by Amanah (trust) is not one of us.

hadiths.arabic:
وعنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏من حلف فقال‏:‏ إني بريء من الإسلام، فإن كان كاذبًا، فهو كما قال، وإن كان صادقًا، فلن يرجع إلى الإسلام سالمًا‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone swears that in such and such case he will be free from Islam and afterwards he turns out to be a liar, he will be as he has sworn; but if he is speaking the truth, he will not revert safely to Islam.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: If anyone swears that in such and such case he will be free from Islam and afterwards he turns out to be a liar, he will be as he has sworn; but if he is speaking the truth, he will not revert safely to Islam.

hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أنه سمع رجلا يقول‏:‏ لا والكعبة، قال ابن عمر‏:‏ لا تحلف بغير الله، فإني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏من حلف بغير الله، فقد كفر أو أشرك‏"‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏ رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن‏)‏‏)‏	وفسر بعض العلماء قوله‏:‏ ‏"‏كفر أو أشرك‏"‏ على التغليظ، كما روي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏"‏الرياء شرك‏"‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah." I admonished him: "Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, 'He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah, has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk'."
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, 'He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah, has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk'.

hadiths.arabic:
عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏من خلف على مال امرئ مسلم بغير حقه، لقي الله وهو عليه غضبان‏"‏ قال‏:‏ ثم قرأ علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  مصداقه من كتاب الله عز وجل‏:‏ ‏{‏إن الذين يشترون بعهد الله وأيمانهم ثمنًا قليلا‏}‏ ‏(‏‏(‏آل عمران‏:‏ 77‏)‏‏)‏ إلى آخر الآية‏:‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muslim unjustly will meet Allah and He will be angry with him" then he recited:"Verily, those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter. Neither will Allah speak to them nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection nor will He purify them, and they shall have a painful torment." (3:77).
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muslim unjustly will meet Allah and He will be angry with him

hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أُمامة إياس بن ثعلبة الحارثي رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  ق��ل‏:‏ ‏"‏من اقتطع حق امرئ مسلم بيمينه، فقد أوجب الله له النار‏.‏ -وحرم عليه الجنة‏"‏ فقال له رجل‏:‏ وإن كان شيئًا يسيرًا يا رسول الله‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏وإن كان قضيبًا من أراك‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim by taking a false oath, Allah will condemn him to the fire of Hell and will forbid Jannah for him." A person asked: "O Messenger of Allah, even if it is something insignificant?" He replied, "Yes, even if it is the twig of the Arak tree.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim by taking a false oath, Allah will condemn him to the fire of Hell and will forbid Jannah for him.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏الكبائر‏:‏ الإشراك بالله، وعقوق الوالدين، وقتل النفس، واليمين الغموس‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ 
وفي رواية‏:‏ أن أعرابيًا جاء إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال‏:‏ يا رسول الله ما الكبائر‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏ ‏الإشراك بالله‏ ‏ قال‏:‏ ثم ماذا‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏ ‏اليمين الغموس‏ ‏ قلت‏:‏ وما اليمين الغموس‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏ ‏الذي يقتطع مال امرئ مسلم‏ ‏ يعني بيمين هو فيها كاذب
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship with Allah, disobedience to the parents, killing without justification and taking a false oath (intentionally).".Another narration is: A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him: "O Messenger of Allah, what are the cardinal sins?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship." The man asked: "(What is) next?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus." He asked: "What do you mean by Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Swearing falsely to usurp the property of a Muslim."
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus.

hadiths.arabic:
عن عبد الرحمن بن سَمُرَة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏وإذا حلفت على يمين، فرأيت غيرها خيرًا منها، فائت الذي هو خير، وكفر عن يمينك‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "When you take an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and choose the better alternative.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: When you take an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and choose the better alternative.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏من حلف على يمين، فرأى غيرها خيرًا منها، فليكفر عن يمينه، وليفعل الذي هو خير‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When you swear an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and do the thing that is better.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: When you swear an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and do the thing that is better.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏إني والله إن شاء الله لا أحلف على يمين، ثم أرى خيرًا منها إلا كفرت عن يميني، وأتيت الذي هو خير‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I shall not swear to do something but that if I consider something else to be better than it, then I shall make expiation for my oath and adopt the thing that is better.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I shall not swear to do something but that if I consider something else to be better than it, then I shall make expiation for my oath and adopt the thing that is better.

hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏لأن يلج أحدكم في يمينه في أهله آثم له عند الله تعالى من أن يعطي كفارته التي فرض الله عليه‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏ قوله‏:‏ ‏"‏يلَجّ‏"‏ بفتح اللام، وتشديد الجيم‏:‏ أي يتمادى فيها، ولا يكفر، قوله‏:‏ ‏"‏آثم‏"‏ هو بالثاء المثلثة، أي‏:‏ أكثر إثمًا‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with Allah than the payment of its expiation prescribed by Allah.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with Allah than the payment of its expiation prescribed by Allah.

hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ أنزلت هذه الآية‏:‏ ‏{‏لا يؤاخذكم الله باللغو في أيمانكم‏}‏ في قول الرجل‏:‏ لا والله، وبلى والله‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.text: The Ayah: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths ..." was revealed in respect of those persons who are in the habit of repeating: 'No, by Allah'; and 'Yes, by Allah.'.
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths ...

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏الحلف منفقة للسلعة، ممحقة للكسب‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing.

hadiths.arabic:
عن أبي قتادة رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏إياكم وكثرة الحلف في البيع، فإنه ينفق ثم يمحق‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Beware of excessive swearing in sale, because it may promote trade but this practice will eliminate the blessing.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Beware of excessive swearing in sale, because it may promote trade but this practice will eliminate the blessing.

hadiths.arabic:
عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا يسأل بوجه الله إلا الجنة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No one should ask in the Face of Allah for anything except Jannah.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: No one should ask in the Face of Allah for anything except Jannah.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏من استعاذ بالله فأعيذوه، ومن سأل بالله، فأعطوه، ومن دعاكم فأجيبوه، ومن صنع إليكم معروفًا فكافئوه، فإن لم تجدوا ما تكافئونه به، فادعوا له حتى تروا أنكم قد كافأتموه‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود والنسائي بأسانيد الصحيحين‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Grant shelter to him who begs for it in the Name of Allah, give to him who begs in the Name of Allah, accept the invitation of him who invites you, and requite him who does a favour to you, but if you are unable to requite him, go on praying for him till you are sure that you have requited him adequately.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Grant shelter to him who begs for it in the Name of Allah, give to him who begs in the Name of Allah, accept the invitation of him who invites you, and requite him who does a favour to you, but if you are unable to requite him, go on praying for him till you are sure that you have requited him adequately.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال‏:‏ ‏
"‏إن أخنع اسم عند الله عز وجل رجل تسمى ملك الأملاك‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ قال سُفيانُ بن عُيَيْنَةَ: «مَلِكُ الأَمْلاَكِ» مِثْلُ: شَاهِن شَاهِ.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most disgraceful man near Allah is a man who calls himself (or likes others to call him) Malikul-Amlak (i.e., king of kings).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The most disgraceful man near Allah is a man who calls himself (or likes others to call him) Malikul-Amlak (i.e., king of kings).

hadiths.arabic:
عن بريدة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا تقولوا للمنافق سيد، فإنه إن يكن سيدًا، فقد أسخطتم ربكم عز وجل‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not address a hypocrite with the title of chief, (or similar titles of respect) for even if he deserves this title you will invite Allah's Wrath by using it for him.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Do not address a hypocrite with the title of chief, (or similar titles of respect) for even if he deserves this title you will invite Allah's Wrath by using it for him.

hadiths.arabic: عن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  دخل على أم السائب، أو أم المسيب فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏مالك يا أم السائب -أو يا أم المسيب- تزفزفين‏؟‏ ‏"‏ قالت‏:‏ الحمى لا بارك الله فيها، فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏لا تسبي الحمى، فإنها تذهب خطايا بني آدم، كما يذهب الكير خبث الحديد‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ «تُزَفْزِفِينَ» أيْ تَتَحَرَّكِينَ حَرَكَةً سَريعَةً، وَمَعْنَاهُ: تَرْتَعِدِين. وَهُوَ بِضَمِّ التاء وبالزاي المكررة والفاء المكررة، وَرُوِيَ أيضًا بالراء المكررة والقافينِ.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab) and asked her, "What ails you O Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab)? You are shivering." She replied: "It is a fever, may Allah not bless it!" He said to her, "Do not revile fever, for it cleanses out the sins of the sons of Adam in the same way that a furnace removes the dirt of iron.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: What ails you O Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab)? You are shivering.

hadiths.arabic:
عن أبي المنذر أبي بن كعب رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا تسبوا الريح، فإذا رأيتم ما تكرهون، فقولوا‏:‏ اللهم إنا نسألك من خير هذه الريح وخير ما فيها وخير ما أُمرت به، ونعوذ بك من شر هذه الريح وشر ما فيها وشر ما أُمرت به‏"‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abominable (about it), supplicate: 'Allahumma inna nas'aluka min khairi hadhihir-rihi, wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma umirat bihi. Wa na'udhu bika min sharri hadhihir-rihi, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma umirat bihi. (O Allah, we beg of You the good of this wind and the good of that which it contains and the good of that which it has been commanded; and we seek refuge in you from the evil of this wind and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of that which it has been commanded).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abominable (about it), supplicate: 'Allahumma inna nas'aluka min khairi hadhihir-rihi, wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma umirat bihi. Wa na'udhu bika min sharri hadhihir-rihi, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma umirat bihi.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏الريح من روح الله، تأتي بالرحمة، وتأتي بالعذاب، فإذا رأيتموها فلا تسبوها، وسلوا الله خيرها، واستعيذوا بالله من شرها‏"‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن‏)‏‏) قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم من روح الله هو بفتح الراء أي رحمته بعباده‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The wind is the Blessing of Allah. Sometimes it brings His Mercy and sometimes it brings His Chastisement. When you experience it, do not revile it but beg of Allah its good; and seek Allah's Refuge against its evil.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: The wind is the Blessing of Allah. Sometimes it brings His Mercy and sometimes it brings His Chastisement. When you experience it, do not revile it but beg of Allah its good; and seek Allah's Refuge against its evil.

hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا عصفت الريح قال‏:‏ اللهم إني أسألك خيرها، وخير ما فيها، وخير ما أُرسلت به، وأعوذ بك من شرها، وشر ما فيها، وشر ما أُرسلت به‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.text: Whenever the wind blew strongly, The Prophet (ﷺ) would say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha, wa khaira ma fiha, wa khaira ma ursilat bihi. Wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bihi. (O Allah, I beg of You its good and the good of that which it contains and the good of the purpose for which it has been sent; and I seek Your Refuge from its evil and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of the purpose for which it has been sent).".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha, wa khaira ma fiha, wa khaira ma ursilat bihi. Wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bihi. (O Allah, I beg of You its good and the good of that which it contains and the good of the purpose for which it has been sent; and I seek Your Refuge from its evil and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of the purpose for which it has been sent).

hadiths.arabic:
عن زيد بن خادل الجهني رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏لا تسبوا الديك، فإنه يوقظ للصلاة‏"‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏ رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
hadiths.narrator: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not revile the rooster for it wakes you up for prayer.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Do not revile the rooster for it wakes you up for prayer.

hadiths.arabic:
عن زيد بن خالد رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ صلى بنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  صلاة الصبح بالحديبية في أثر سماء كانت من الليل، فلما انصرف أقبل على الناس، فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏هل تدرون ماذا قال ربكم‏؟‏ ‏"‏ قالوا‏:‏ الله ورسوله أعلم‏.‏ قال‏:‏  قال‏:‏ ‏"‏أصبح من عبادي مؤمن بي وكافر بي ، فأما من قال‏:‏ مُطِرْنَا بفضل الله ورحمته، فذلك مؤمن بي كافر بالكواكب، وأما من قال‏:‏ مُطِرْنَا بنوء كذا وكذا، فذلك كافر بي مؤمن بالكواكب‏"‏ ‏(‏���(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
والسماء هنا‏:‏ المطر‏‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the Fajr prayer at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of prayer, he turned towards the people and said, "Do you know what your Rubb has said?" They replied: "Allah and His Messenger know better." Upon this he remarked, "He has said: 'Some of My slaves have entered the morning as My believers and some as unbelievers. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Grace and Mercy of Allah, believes in Me and disbelieves in the stars; and he who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such star, disbelieves in Me and affirms his faith in the stars."'.
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: Do you know what your Rubb has said?

hadiths.arabic:
عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏
"‏إذا قال رجل لأخيه‏:‏ يا كافر، فقد باء بها أحدهما، فإن كان كما قال وإلا رجعت عليه‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a disbeliever, one of them will certainly deserve the title. If the addressee is so as he has asserted, the disbelief of the man is confirmed, but if it is untrue, then it will revert to him.".
hadiths.topic: The Book of the Prohibited actions
hadiths.summary: When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a disbeliever, one of them will certainly deserve the title. If the addressee is so as he has asserted, the disbelief of the man is confirmed, but if it is untrue, then it will revert to him.

hadiths.arabic:
وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول‏:‏ ‏
"‏من دعا رجلا بالكفر، أو قال‏:‏ عدو الله، وليس كذلك إلا حار عليه‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
حار‏ ‏ رجع‏‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
