hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عُثْمَانَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- { أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-كَانَ يُخَلِّلُ لِحْيَتَهُ فِي اَلْوُضُوءِ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلتِّرْمِذِيُّ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ خُزَيْمَة َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه الترمذي (31)‏، وابن خزيمة (1 /78‏-79)‏ وقال الترمذي: حسن صحيح.‏ قلت: يعني بشواهده، فله شواهد عن أكثر من عشرة من الصحابة رضي الله عنهم، وقد ذكرت ذلك مفصلا في "الأصل".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Uthman (rad):
hadiths.text: While performing Wudu, the Prophet (ﷺ) would run (his fingers) through his beard. .
hadiths.summary: While performing Wudu, the Prophet (ﷺ) would run (his fingers) through his beard. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- { أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-أَتَى بِثُلُثَيْ مُدٍّ, فَجَعَلَ يَدْلُكُ ذِرَاعَيْهِ }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَحْمَدُ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ خُزَيْمَة َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أحمد (4/39)‏، وابن خزيمة (118)‏ واللفظ لابن خزيمة.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Abdullah bin Zaid (rad):
hadiths.text: Two thirds of a Mudd (of water) was brought to he Prophet (ﷺ) (for ablution) so he began rubbing his arms. .
hadiths.summary: Two thirds of a Mudd (of water) was brought to he Prophet (ﷺ) (for ablution) so he began rubbing his arms. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْهُ, { أَنَّهُ رَأَى اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَأْخُذُ لِأُذُنَيْهِ مَاءً خِلَافَ اَلْمَاءِ اَلَّذِي أَخَذَ لِرَأْسِهِ.‏ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلْبَيْهَقِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- البيهقي (1 /65)‏ وقال: "هذا إسناد صحيح".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Abdullah bin Zaid (rad):
hadiths.text: He saw the Prophet (ﷺ) taking some water to wipe his ears other than the water he had taken to wipe his head. .
hadiths.summary: He saw the Prophet (ﷺ) taking some water to wipe his ears other than the water he had taken to wipe his head. .

hadiths.arabic:
وَهُوَ عِنْدَ 
"مُسْلِمٍ" مِنْ هَذَا اَلْوَجْهِ بِلَفْظٍ: وَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ بِمَاءٍ غَيْرَ فَضْلِ يَدَيْهِ, وَهُوَ اَلْمَحْفُوظ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (236)‏، وقال البيهقي: "وهذا أصح من الذي قبله" .‏
hadiths.narrator: And the words of the Muslim version are:
hadiths.text: “he wiped his head taking extra water from that he had taken for the washing of the hands”, and this Hadith is Al-Mahfuz.
hadiths.summary: he wiped his head taking extra water from that he had taken for the washing of the hands

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَقُولُ: { "إِنَّ أُمَّتِي يَأْتُونَ يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ غُرًّا مُحَجَّلِينَ, مِنْ أَثَرِ اَلْوُضُوءِ, فَمَنْ اِسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يُطِيلَ غُرَّتَهُ فَلْيَفْعَلْ.‏ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ, وَاللَّفْظُ لِمُسْلِم ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (136)‏، ومسلم (246)‏ (35)‏ وقوله: "فمن استطاع …" مدرج من كلام أبي هريرة.‏ والله أعلم.‏
hadiths.narrator: Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: I heard Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) saying, “My people will come on the Day of Resurrection with bright faces, hands and feet from the traces of Wudu. If any of you can lengthen his brightness, let him do so”. .
hadiths.summary: My people will come on the Day of Resurrection with bright faces, hands and feet from the traces of Wudu. If any of you can lengthen his brightness, let him do so

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: { كَانَ اَلنَّبِيُّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يُعْجِبُهُ اَلتَّيَمُّنُ فِي تَنَعُّلِهِ, وَتَرَجُّلِهِ, وَطُهُورِهُ, وَفِي شَأْنِهِ كُلِّهِ.‏ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (168)‏، ومسلم (268)‏ (67)‏ من طريق مسروق، عن عائشة، به .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (rad) loved to begin with the right while putting on his shoes, combing his hair, in his purification and in all his affairs .
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (rad) loved to begin with the right while putting on his shoes, combing his hair, in his purification and in all his affairs .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتُمْ فابدأوا بِمَيَامِنِكُمْ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلْأَرْبَعَةُ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ خُزَيْمَة َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (4141)‏، والترمذي (1766)‏، والنسائي في "الكبرى" (5 /482)‏، وابن ماجه (402)‏، وابن خزيمة (178)‏ واللفظ لابن ماجه.‏ وأما لفظ أبي داود، وابن خزيمة، فهو: "إذا لبستم، وإذا توضأتم فابدأوا بأيامنكم".‏ وأما الترمذي والنسائي فلفظهما: كان إذا ليس قميصا بدأ بميامنه.‏ ومن هذا يتضح لك خطأ الحافظ رحمه الله في عزوه الحديث لمخرجيه هكذا على الإطلاق.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (rad) said: “When you perform ablution, begin with your right limbs”. .
hadiths.summary: When you perform ablution, begin with your right limbs

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- { أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-تَوَضَّأَ, فَمَسَحَ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ, وَعَلَى اَلْعِمَامَةِ وَالْخُفَّيْنِ.‏ }  أَخْرَجَهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏  .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (274)‏ (83)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu’ba (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution and passed wet hands on his forelock, over the turban and over the two leather socks. .
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution and passed wet hands on his forelock, over the turban and over the two leather socks. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ جَابِرٍ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا ‏-فِي صِفَةِ حَجِّ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ‏- قَالَ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ اِبْدَؤُوا بِمَا بَدَأَ اَللَّهُ بِهِ }  أَخْرَجَهُ النَّسَائِيُّ, هَكَذَا بِلَفْظِ اَلْأَمْر ِ  1‏ وَهُوَ عِنْدَ مُسْلِمٍ بِلَفْظِ اَلْخَبَر ِ  2‏  .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ النسائي (536)‏.‏‏2 ‏- مسلم (2/888)‏، أي: بلفظ: "أبدأ" وانظر رقم (742)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah (rad):
hadiths.text: Regarding the Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ): He said, “Begin with what Allah had begun with” .
hadiths.summary: Begin with what Allah had begun with

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: { كَانَ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَدَارَ اَلْمَاءَ عَلَى مُرْفَقَيْهِ.‏ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِ ضَعِيف ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف جدا.‏ رواه الدارقطني (1/15/83)‏ .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to run the water down his elbows while performing ablution .
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to run the water down his elbows while performing ablution .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ لَا وُضُوءَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اِسْمَ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَحْمَدُ, وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ, وَابْنُ مَاجَهْ, بِإِسْنَادٍ ضَعِيف ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- حسن بشواهده .‏ رواه أحمد (2/418)‏، وأبو داود (101)‏، وابن ماجه (399)‏ .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “There is no Wudu for one who does not mention Allah’s Name upon it. .
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “There is no Wudu for one who does not mention Allah’s Name upon it. .

hadiths.arabic: وَلِلترْمِذِيِّ: عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْد ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- سنن الترمذي (25)‏.‏
hadiths.text: At-Tirmidhi reported something similar to the above from Sa’id bin Zaid.
hadiths.summary: At-Tirmidhi reported something similar to the above from Sa’id bin Zaid.

hadiths.arabic: وَأَبِي سَعِيدٍ نَحْوُه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- "العلل الكبير" (112‏-113)‏ .‏
hadiths.text: and Abu Sa’id like this.
hadiths.summary: and Abu Sa’id like this.

hadiths.arabic: قَالَ أَحْمَدُ: لَا يَثْبُتُ فِيهِ شَيْء ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- كما في "مسائل ابن هانيء" (1/16/3)‏.‏ قلت: ولكن الحديث حسن بشواهده، وصححه غير واحد من الحافظ، وقد فصلت القول فيه في "الأصل".‏
hadiths.text: and Ahmad said that nothing is authenticated in it.
hadiths.summary: and Ahmad said that nothing is authenticated in it.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ, عَنْ أَبِيهِ, عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ: { رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَ اَلْمَضْمَضَةِ وَالِاسْتِنْشَاقِ.‏ }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ بِإِسْنَادِ ضَعِيف ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أبو داود (139)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Talha bin Musarrif, quoting his father on the authority of his grandfather:
hadiths.text: “I saw Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) rinsing his mouth and sniffing up and blowing his nose with separate scops of water.” .
hadiths.summary: I saw Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) rinsing his mouth and sniffing up and blowing his nose with separate scops of water.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- ‏-فِي صِفَةِ اَلْوُضُوءِ‏- { ثُمَّ تَمَضْمَضَ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلَاثًا, يُمَضْمِضُ وَيَنْثِرُ مِنْ اَلْكَفِّ اَلَّذِي يَأْخُذُ مِنْهُ اَلْمَاءَ }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالنَّسَائِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ وهو جزء من الحديث المتقدم برقم (34)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Ali (rad) regarding performance of Wudu:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) rinsed his mouth and sniffed and blew (his nose) with water three times. He sniffed up and blew his nose with the same hand from which he took the water.
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) rinsed his mouth and sniffed and blew (his nose) with water three times. He sniffed up and blew his nose with the same hand from which he took the water.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- ‏-فِي صِفَةِ اَلْوُضُوءِ‏- { ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَدَهُ, فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ مِنْ كَفٍّ وَاحِدَةٍ, يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ثَلَاثًا }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ وهو جزء من الحديث المتقدم برقم (35)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Abdullah bin Zaid (rad) regarding Wudu:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) put his hand (in the utensil) rinsed (his mouth) and sniffed up and blew (his nose) from one scoop (of water). He did that three times. .
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) put his hand (in the utensil) rinsed (his mouth) and sniffed up and blew (his nose) from one scoop (of water). He did that three times. .

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { رَأَى اَلنَّبِيُّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-رَجُلًا, وَفِي قَدَمِهِ مِثْلُ اَلظُّفْرِ لَمْ يُصِبْهُ اَلْمَاءُ.‏ فَقَالَ: 
"اِرْجِعْ فَأَحْسِنْ وُضُوءَكَ" }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ, وَالنَّسَائِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (173)‏.‏ ووهم الحافظ ‏-رحمه الله‏- في عزوه للنسائي، إذا لم يروه لا في "الكبرى" ولا في "الصغرى" والله أعلم.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man on whose foot appeared a portion like the size of a nail which was not touched by water. He then said, “Go back and perform your Wudu properly.” .
hadiths.summary: Go back and perform your Wudu properly.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَتَوَضَّأُ بِالْمُدِّ, وَيَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ إِلَى خَمْسَةِ أَمْدَادٍ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (201)‏، ومسلم (325)‏ (51)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used only one Mudd of water for ablution and one Sa’ to five Mudd of water for his bath .
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used only one Mudd of water for ablution and one Sa’ to five Mudd of water for his bath .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَتَوَضَّأُ, فَيُسْبِغُ اَلْوُضُوءَ, ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اَللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ, وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ, إِلَّا فُتِحَتْ لَهُ أَبْوَابُ اَلْجَنَّةِ" }  أَخْرَجَهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (234)‏ عن عقبة بن عامر قال: كانت علينا رعاية الإبل، فجاءت نوبتي، فروحتها بعشي، فأدركت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قائما يحدث الناس، فأدركت من قوله: "ما من مسلم يتوضأ فيحسن وضوءه، ثم يقوم فيصلى ركعتين، مقبل عليهما بقلبه ووجهه، إلا وجبت له الجنة" قال: فقلت: ما أجود هذه، فإذا قاتل بين يدي يقول: التي قبلها أجود، فنظرت فإذا عمر.‏ قال: إني قد رأيتك جئت آنفا، قال: فذكره.‏ وزاد: "الثمانية، يدخل من أيها شاء".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Umar (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “If one after performing ablution completely recites the following supplication: (Ash-hadu an la ilaha ill-Allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ash hadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa Rasuluhu) ‘I testify that there is no one worthy of worship but Allah, He is Alone and has no partner and Muhammad (ﷺ) is his slave and Messenger’, all the eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him and he may enter through any gate he wishes”.
hadiths.summary: If one after performing ablution completely recites the following supplication: (Ash-hadu an la ilaha ill-Allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ash hadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa Rasuluhu) ‘I testify that there is no one worthy of worship but Allah, He is Alone and has no partner and Muhammad (ﷺ) is his slave and Messenger’, all the eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him and he may enter through any gate he wishes

hadiths.arabic: وَاَلتِّرْمِذِيُّ, وَزَادَ: { اَللَّهُمَّ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنْ اَلتَّوَّابِينَ, وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ اَلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- سنن الترمذي (55)‏، وهذه الزيادة ا��تي عند الترمذي لا تصح، كما هو مبين "بالأصل".‏
hadiths.narrator: Reported by Muslim and At-Tirmidhi who added the following words to the supplication:
hadiths.text: (Allahumma aj’alni minat-tawwabina waj’alni minAl-mutatahhirina) “Oh Allah! Include me among those who repent and those who keep themselves pure”.
hadiths.summary: Oh Allah! Include me among those who repent and those who keep themselves pure

hadiths.arabic:
عَنْ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { كُنْتُ مَعَ اَلنَّبِيِّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-فَتَوَضَّأَ, فَأَهْوَيْتُ لِأَنْزِعَ خُفَّيْهِ, فَقَالَ: 
"دَعْهُمَا, فَإِنِّي أَدْخَلْتُهُمَا طَاهِرَتَيْنِ" فَمَسَحَ عَلَيْهِمَا }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (206)‏، ومسلم (274)‏ (79)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Mughira bin Shu’ba (rad):
hadiths.text: Once I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ), he then performed ablution and I dashed to take off his socks. He said, “Leave them for I had put them on after performing ablution”. So he wiped over them .
hadiths.summary: Leave them for I had put them on after performing ablution

hadiths.arabic: وَلِلْأَرْبَعَةِ عَنْهُ إِلَّا النَّسَائِيَّ: { أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-مَسَحَ أَعْلَى اَلْخُفِّ وَأَسْفَلَهُ }  وَفِي إِسْنَادِهِ ضَعْف ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أبو داود (165)‏، والترمذي (97)‏، وابن ماجه (550)‏ وله عدة علل، وقد ضعفه جمع كثير من الأئمة.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated by Al-Arba’a except An-Nasa’i:
hadiths.text:
The Prophet (ﷺ) wiped over the upper part of the leather socks and the under part of it.
.
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) wiped over the upper part of the leather socks and the under part of it. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { لَوْ كَانَ اَلدِّينُ بِالرَّأْيِ لَكَانَ أَسْفَلُ اَلْخُفِّ أَوْلَى بِالْمَسْحِ مِنْ أَعْلَاهُ, وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَمْسَحُ عَلَى ظَاهِرِ خُفَّيْهِ }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ بِإِسْنَادٍ حَسَن ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (162)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Ali (rad):
hadiths.text: If the religion were based on opinion, it would be more important to wipe over the under parts of the leather socks than the upper, but I have seen Allah’s Messenger  (rad) wiping over the upper parts of his leather socks. .
hadiths.summary: If the religion were based on opinion, it would be more important to wipe over the under parts of the leather socks than the upper, but I have seen Allah’s Messenger (rad) wiping over the upper parts of his leather socks. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَسَّالٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَأْمُرُنَا إِذَا كُنَّا سَفْرًا أَنْ لَا نَنْزِعَ خِفَافَنَا ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَلَيَالِيَهُنَّ, إِلَّا مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ وَلَكِنْ مِنْ غَائِطٍ, وَبَوْلٍ, وَنَوْمٍ }  أَخْرَجَهُ النَّسَائِيُّ, وَاَلتِّرْمِذِيُّ وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ, وَابْنُ خُزَيْمَةَ وَصَحَّحَاه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- حسن.‏ رواه النسائي (1/83‏-84)‏، والترمذي (96)‏، وابن خزيمة (196)‏، وقال الترمذي: حسن صحيح.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Safwan bin ‘Assal (rad):
hadiths.text: When we were on a journey, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to command us to wear our leather socks for three days and three nights, whether we had to answer the call of nature or slept. However, in case of ejaculation or sexual impurity, he commanded us to remove the leather socks. .
hadiths.summary: When we were on a journey, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to command us to wear our leather socks for three days and three nights, whether we had to answer the call of nature or slept. However, in case of ejaculation or sexual impurity, he commanded us to remove the leather socks. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { جَعَلَ اَلنَّبِيُّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَلَيَالِيَهُنَّ لِلْمُسَافِرِ, وَيَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً لِلْمُقِيمِ.‏ يَعْنِي: فِي اَلْمَسْحِ عَلَى اَلْخُفَّيْنِ }  أَخْرَجَهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (276)‏ من طريق شريح بن هانيء، قال: أتيت عائشة أسألها عن المسح على الخفين؟ فقالت: عليك بابن أبي طالب فسله، فإنه كان يسافر مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم.‏ فسألناه فقال: فذكره دون قوله: يعني في المسح على الخفين، فإن هذه الجملة من صياغة الحافظ.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Ali (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet  (ﷺ) fixed the period of Mash (wiping) over the leather socks (Khifaf – plural of Khuff) for three days and nights for a traveller and one day and a night for the resident person in a town .
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) fixed the period of Mash (wiping) over the leather socks (Khifaf – plural of Khuff) for three days and nights for a traveller and one day and a night for the resident person in a town .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ ثَوْبَانَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-سَرِيَّةً, فَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَمْسَحُوا عَلَى اَلْعَصَائِبِ ‏- يَعْنِي: اَلْعَمَائِمَ ‏-وَالتَّسَاخِينِ‏- يَعْنِي: اَلْخِفَافَ }  رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ, وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اَلْحَاكِم ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أحمد (577)‏، وأبو داود (146)‏، والحاكم (169)‏، وقد أعل الحديث بما لا يقدح.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Thawban (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) sent out a military expedition and commanded them to wipe over the turbans and leather socks. .
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) sent out a military expedition and commanded them to wipe over the turbans and leather socks. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ ‏-مَوْقُوفًا‏- و]عَنْ] أَنَسٍ ‏-مَرْفُوعًا‏-: { إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَلَبِسَ خُفَّيْهِ فَلْيَمْسَحْ عَلَيْهِمَا, وَلْيُصَلِّ فِيهِمَا, وَلَا يَخْلَعْهُمَا إِنْ شَاءَ إِلَّا مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ" }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ, وَالْحَاكِمُ وَصَحَّحَه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- انظر الدارقطني (103 ‏- 204)‏، والحاكم (181)‏ .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Umar (rad), in a Mawquf (untraceable) and Anas in a Marfu (traceable) Hadith:
hadiths.text: “If one of you performs ablution and puts on his two leather socks, let him perform Mash (wipe) over them and pray in them and he may not take them off he so wishes except after ejaculation or sexual impurity. .
hadiths.summary: “If one of you performs ablution and puts on his two leather socks, let him perform Mash (wipe) over them and pray in them and he may not take them off he so wishes except after ejaculation or sexual impurity. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- عَنْ اَلنَّبِيِّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ أَنَّهُ رَخَّصَ لِلْمُسَافِرِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَلَيَالِيَهُنَّ, وَلِلْمُقِيمِ يَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً, إِذَا تَطَهَّرَ فَلَبِسَ خُفَّيْهِ: أَنْ يَمْسَحَ عَلَيْهِمَا }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ خُزَيْمَة َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- حسن.‏ رواه الدارقطني (194)‏، وابن خزيمة (192)‏، وهو وإن كان ضعيف السند، إلا أن له شواهد ذكرتها "بالأصل" ومن أجل ذلك حسنة البخاري، كما نقل عنه الترمذي في "العلل".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Bakra (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave permission for the traveller to perform Mash (wiping) over his leather socks for three days and nights and for a non-traveller for a day and night, if he had put them on in a state of purity. .
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave permission for the traveller to perform Mash (wiping) over his leather socks for three days and nights and for a non-traveller for a day and night, if he had put them on in a state of purity. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ عِمَارَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- أَنَّهُ قَالَ: { يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ أَمْسَحُ عَلَى اَلْخُفَّيْنِ? قَالَ: "نَعَمْ" قَالَ: يَوْمًا? قَالَ: "نَعَمْ", قَالَ: وَيَوْمَيْنِ? قَالَ: "نَعَمْ", قَالَ: وَثَلَاثَةً? قَالَ: "نَعَمْ, وَمَا شِئْتَ" أَخْرَجَهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ, وَقَالَ: لَيْسَ بِالْقَوِيِّ }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أبو داود (158)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Ubai bin ‘Imara (rad):
hadiths.text: I asked, “O Messenger of Allah, may I wipe over the Khuffain (leather socks)?” The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, “Yes”. I asked, “For one day?” He replied, “For one day”, I again asked, “And for two days?” He replied “For two day s too”. I again asked “And for three days” He replied, “Yes, as long as you wish”.
hadiths.summary: O Messenger of Allah, may I wipe over the Khuffain (leather socks)?

hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { كَانَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-‏-عَلَى عَهْدِهِ‏- يَنْتَظِرُونَ اَلْعِشَاءَ حَتَّى تَخْفِقَ رُؤُوسُهُمْ, ثُمَّ يُصَلُّونَ وَلَا يَتَوَضَّئُونَ }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح .‏ رواه أبو داود (200)‏، والدارقطني (1/131/3)‏ وقال الدار قطني: صحيح .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas (rad):
hadiths.text: The Companions of Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) in his lifetime used to wait for the ‘Isha (night) prayer, so much so that their heads were lowered down  (by dozing). They would then pray without performing ablution. .
hadiths.summary: The Companions of Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) in his lifetime used to wait for the ‘Isha (night) prayer, so much so that their heads were lowered down (by dozing). They would then pray without performing ablution. .

hadiths.arabic: وَأَصْلُهُ فِي مُسْلِم ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- مسلم ( 376 )‏ ولفظه: كان أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ينامون.‏ ثم يصلون ولا يتوضأون .‏ وله روايات أخرى ذكرتها "بالأصل".‏
hadiths.text: Its origin is in Muslim.
hadiths.summary: Its origin is in Muslim.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: { جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ إِلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ! إِنِّي اِمْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلَا أَطْهُرُ, أَفَأَدَعُ اَلصَّلَاةَ? قَالَ: "لَا.‏ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ عِرْقٌ, وَلَيْسَ بِحَيْضٍ, فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتْ حَيْضَتُكِ فَدَعِي اَلصَّلَاةَ, وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ اَلدَّمَ, ثُمَّ صَلِّي }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (328)‏، ومسلم (333)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text: Fatima bint Abu Hubaish came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, “O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman whose blood keeps flowing (even after the menstruation). I am never purified; should I, therefore, stop praying?” He (the Prophet) said: “No, for that is only a vein, and is not menstruation. So when the menstruation comes, abstain from prayers, and when it ends wash the blood from yourself and then pray”. .
hadiths.summary: O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman whose blood keeps flowing (even after the menstruation). I am never purified; should I, therefore, stop praying?

hadiths.narrator: Al-Bukhari’s version adds:
hadiths.text: “Then perform ablution for every prayer”.
hadiths.summary: Then perform ablution for every prayer

hadiths.arabic: وَأَشَارَ مُسْلِمٌ إِلَى أَنَّهُ حَذَفَهَا عَمْدً ا  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- إذ قال: "وفي حديث حماد بن زيد زيادة حرف تركنا ذكره".‏ قلت: ومثل ذلك قال النسائي، ولكن لم يتفرد حماد بهذه الزيادة، كما بينته في "الأصل".‏
hadiths.text: and Muslim admitted that he dropped this addition deliberately.
hadiths.summary: and Muslim admitted that he dropped this addition deliberately.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مَذَّاءً, فَأَمَرْتُ اَلْمِقْدَادَ بْنَ اَلْأَسْوَدِ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-فَسَأَلَهُ ? فَقَالَ: "فِيهِ اَلْوُضُوءُ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ, وَاللَّفْظُ لِلْبُخَارِيّ ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (132)‏، ومسلم (303)‏، ولفظ مسلم: (منه)‏ بدل (فيه)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Ali bin Abi Talib (rad):
hadiths.text: I was one who Madhi (urethral discharge) flowed readily and asked Miqdad (his slave) to ask the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. He (the Prophet) said:“One should perform Wudu (ablution) in this case”. .
hadiths.summary: One should perform Wudu (ablution) in this case

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ, رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا; { أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-قَبَّلَ بَعْضَ نِسَائِهِ, ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى اَلصَّلَاةِ وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَحْمَدُ, وَضَعَّفَهُ اَلْبُخَارِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أحمد (610)‏، وهو وإن ضعفه البخاري، وأعله غيره إلا أن هناك من صححه وهو الصواب.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) kissed one of his wives and went to pray without performing (fresh) ablution. .
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) kissed one of his wives and went to pray without performing (fresh) ablution. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ إِذَا وَجَدَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي بَطْنِهِ شَيْئًا, فَأَشْكَلَ عَلَيْهِ: أَخَرَجَ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ, أَمْ لَا? فَلَا يَخْرُجَنَّ مِنْ اَلْمَسْجِدِ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ صَوْتًا, أَوْ يَجِدَ رِيحًا }  أَخْرَجَهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ مسلم (362)‏ .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “If one of you feels disturbance in his stomach and doubts whether he has released some wind or not, then he should not leave the mosque unless he hears its sound or smells (its) odour”. .
hadiths.summary: If one of you feels disturbance in his stomach and doubts whether he has released some wind or not, then he should not leave the mosque unless he hears its sound or smells (its) odour

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ طَلْقِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { قَالَ رَجُلٌ: مَسَسْتُ ذَكَرِي أَوْ قَالَ اَلرَّجُلُ يَمَسُّ ذَكَرَهُ فِي اَلصَّلَاةِ, أَعَلَيْهِ وُضُوءٍ ? فَقَالَ اَلنَّبِيُّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-"لَا, إِنَّمَا هُوَ بَضْعَةٌ مِنْكَ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلْخَمْسَةُ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ حِبَّان َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- حسن.‏ رواه أبو داود (182 و 183)‏، والنسائي (101)‏، والترمذي (85)‏، وابن ماجه (483)‏، وأحمد (43)‏، وابن حبان (207 موارد)‏.‏ ولكن ينبغي معرفة أن هذا الحديث منسوخ، إذ قال ابن حزم في "المحلي" (139)‏ ولنعم ما قال: "هذا الخبر ‏-خبر طلق‏- صحيح إلا أنهم لا حجة لهم فيه لوجوه: أحدها: أن هذا الخبر موافق لما كان الناس عليه قبل ورود الأمر بالوضوء من مس الفرج، هذا لا شك فيه، فإذا هو كذلك فحكمه منسوخ يقينا حين أمر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالوضوء من مس الفرج، ولا يحل ترك ما تيقن أنه ناسخ، والأخذ بما تيقن أنه منسوخ.‏ وثانيها: أن كلامه عليه السلام: "هل هو إلا بضعة منك؟" دليل بين على أنه كان قبل الأمر بالوضوء منه؛ لأنه لو كان بعده لم يقل عليه السلام هذا الكلام، بل كان يبين أن الأمر بذلك قد نسخ، وقوله هذا يدل على أنه لم يكن سلف فيه حكم أصلا، وأنه كسائر الأعضاء" .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Talq bin ‘Ali (rad):
hadiths.text: A man said: “I touched my penis” or he said, “Does a man who touch his penis during the prayer should perform Wudu (ablution)?” The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, “No, it is only a part of your body”. [Reported by Al-Khamsa. Ibn Hibban graded it Sahih (sound).
hadiths.summary: Does a man who touch his penis during the prayer should perform Wudu (ablution)?

hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ اِبْنُ اَلْمَدِينِيِّ: هُوَ أَحْسَنُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ بُسْرَةَ.‏
hadiths.text: and Ibn Al-Madini said, “It is better than the Hadith of Busra".
hadiths.summary: It is better than the Hadith of Busra

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْ بُسْرَةَ بِنْتِ صَفْوَانَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا; { أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-قَالَ: 
"مَنْ مَسَّ ذَكَرَهُ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ" }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلْخَمْسَةُ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اَلتِّرْمِذِيُّ, وَابْنُ حِبَّان َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (181)‏، والنسائي (100)‏، والترمذي (82)‏، وابن ماجه (479)‏، وأحمد (6 /406)‏، وابن حبان (212 موارد)‏.‏ وقد أعل هذا الحديث بما لا يقدح، كما هو مبين "بالأصل".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Busra bint Safwan (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “He who touches his penis should perform ablution”. [Reported by Al-Khamsa, and At-Tirmidhi and Ibn Hibban graded it Sahih (sound).
hadiths.summary: He who touches his penis should perform ablution

hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ اَلْبُخَارِيُّ: هُوَ أَصَحُّ شَيْءٍ فِي هَذَا اَلْبَابِ.‏
hadiths.text: and Al-Bukhari said, “It is the most authentic in this chapter”.
hadiths.summary: It is the most authentic in this chapter

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا; أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: { مَنْ أَصَابَهُ قَيْءٌ أَوْ رُعَافٌ, أَوْ قَلَسٌ, أَوْ مَذْيٌ فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ, ثُمَّ لِيَبْنِ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِ, وَهُوَ فِي ذَلِكَ لَا يَتَكَلَّمُ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اِبْنُ مَاجَ ه  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه ابن ماجه (1221)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text:
Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “Whoever vomits, bleeds through the nose, or released Madhi (urethral discharge) should go, perform ablution and then complete his Salat (prayer) (by continuing from where he had stopped at) on condition that he does not speak in the process”. 
Reported by Ibn Majah
hadiths.summary: Whoever vomits, bleeds through the nose, or released Madhi (urethral discharge) should go, perform ablution and then complete his Salat (prayer) (by continuing from where he had stopped at) on condition that he does not speak in the process

hadiths.arabic: وَضَعَّفَهُ أَحْمَدُ وَغَيْرُهُ.‏
hadiths.text: and Ahmad and others graded it Da’if
hadiths.summary: and Ahmad and others graded it Da’if

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا; { أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-أَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ لُحُومِ اَلْغَنَمِ? قَالَ: إِنْ شِئْتَ قَالَ: أَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ لُحُومِ اَلْإِبِلِ ? قَالَ: نَعَمْ }  أَخْرَجَهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (360)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Jabir bin Samura (rad):
hadiths.text:
A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ), “Should I perform ablution after eating mutton?” He replied, “If you wish so”, he then asked, “Should I perform ablution after eating camel meat?” He (ﷺ) said: “Yes”.
.
hadiths.summary: Should I perform ablution after eating mutton?

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ مَنْ غَسَّلَ مَيْتًا فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ, وَمَنْ حَمَلَهُ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ }  أَخْرَجَهُ أَحْمَدُ, وَالنَّسَائِيُّ, وَاَلتِّرْمِذِيُّ وَحَسَّنَه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أحمد رقم (7675)‏، والترمذي (993)‏.‏ والحديث قد أعله جماعة كالإمام أحمد كما نقل الحافظ ولكن طرق الحديث وشواهده الكثيرة لا تدع أدنى شك في تصحيحه، وانظر "الأصل" إن شئت معرفة ذلك.‏ "تنبيه": وهم الحافظ عي عزوه للنسائي.‏ والله أعلم .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Whoever washes a dead person should take a bath (thereafter); and whoever carries it should perform ablution”. Reported by Ahmad, An-Nasa’i and At-Tirmidhi who graded it Hasan (fair).
hadiths.summary: Whoever washes a dead person should take a bath (thereafter); and whoever carries it should perform ablution

hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ: لَا يَصِحُّ فِي هَذَا اَلْبَابِ شَيْءٌ.‏
hadiths.text: And Ahmad said that there is no authentic Hadith in this chapter.
hadiths.summary: And Ahmad said that there is no authentic Hadith in this chapter.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رَحِمَهُ اَللَّهُ; { أَنَّ فِي اَلْكِتَابِ اَلَّذِي كَتَبَهُ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-لِعَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ: أَنْ لَا يَمَسَّ اَلْقُرْآنَ إِلَّا طَاهِرٌ }  رَوَاهُ مَالِكٌ مُرْسَلاً, وَوَصَلَهُ النَّسَائِيُّ, وَابْنُ حِبَّانَ, وَهُوَ مَعْلُولٌ.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Abdullah bin Abu Bakr (rad):
hadiths.text: The book written by Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) for ‘Amr bin Hazm also contained: “ None except a pure person should touch the Quran”. .
hadiths.summary: None except a pure person should touch the Quran

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يُذْكُرُ اَللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ أَحْيَانِهِ }  رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ, وَعَلَّقَهُ اَلْبُخَارِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ علقه البخاري (214/فتح)‏، ووصله مسلم (373)‏ .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text:
Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used to mention Allah’s Name (praise Him) at all times.
.
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used to mention Allah’s Name (praise Him) at all times. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَنَسِ]بْنِ مَالِكٍ] ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- { أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-اِحْتَجَمَ وَصَلَّى, وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ, وَلَيَّنَه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه الدارقطني (151‏-152)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas bin Malik (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) had blood extracted from his body and offered the prayer and did not perform (a new) ablution. .
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) had blood extracted from his body and offered the prayer and did not perform (a new) ablution. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ الْعَيْنُ وِكَاءُ السَّهِ, فَإِذَا نَامَتْ اَلْعَيْنَانِ اِسْتَطْلَقَ اَلْوِكَاءُ }  رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ, وَالطَّبَرَانِيُّ وَزَادَ { وَمَنْ نَامَ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ }
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Mu’awiyah (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (saW) said: “The eye (when awake) is the string of the anus (to stop air escaping), and if the two eyes sleep the string is untied”. ”
hadiths.summary: The eye (when awake) is the string of the anus (to stop air escaping), and if the two eyes sleep the string is untied

hadiths.arabic: وَهَذِهِ اَلزِّيَادَةُ فِي هَذَا اَلْحَدِيثِ عِنْدَ أَبِي دَاوُدَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَلِيٍّ دُونَ قَوْلِهِ: { اِسْتَطْلَقَ اَلْوِكَاءُ }  وَفِي كِلَا الْإِسْنَادَيْنِ ضَعْف ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- حسن.‏ رواه أحمد (4/97)‏، وأبو داود (203)‏ وفي الأصل زيادة تفصيل.‏
hadiths.text: Also reported by Abu Da’ud mentioning the above addition without the words “the string is untied”, but both versions are weak.
hadiths.summary: Also reported by Abu Da’ud mentioning the above addition without the words “the string is untied”, but both versions are weak.

hadiths.arabic: وَلِأَبِي دَاوُدَ أَيْضًا, عَنْ اِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ مَرْفُوعًا: { إِنَّمَا اَلْوُضُوءُ عَلَى مَنْ نَامَ مُضْطَجِعًا }  وَفِي إِسْنَادِهِ ضَعْفٌ أَيْضً ا  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- منكر.‏ رواه أبو داود (202)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: And Ibn ‘Abbas (rad) narrated in a Marfu’ (traceable) Hadith that:
hadiths.text: “Ablution is necessary for one who sleeps while he is lying flat. .
hadiths.summary: “Ablution is necessary for one who sleeps while he is lying flat. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنِ اِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا; أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-قَالَ: { يَأْتِي أَحَدَكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ فِي صَلَاتِهِ, فَيَنْفُخُ فِي مَقْعَدَتِهِ فَيُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ أَحْدَثَ, وَلَمْ يُحْدِثْ, فَإِذَا وَجَدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَا يَنْصَرِفُ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ صَوْتًا أَوْ يَجِدَ رِيحًا }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلْبَزَّار ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- رواه البزار (281)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Ibn ‘Abbas (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “Satan comes to one of you in Salat and blows air in his bottom, so he imagines that he has realised air yet he did not. So if he gets that feeling he should not leave his prayer unless he hears the sound (of the air) or smells its odour.” .
hadiths.summary: Satan comes to one of you in Salat and blows air in his bottom, so he imagines that he has realised air yet he did not. So if he gets that feeling he should not leave his prayer unless he hears the sound (of the air) or smells its odour.

hadiths.arabic: وَأَصْلُهُ فِي اَلصَّحِيحَيْنِ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْد ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ ولفظه: شكي إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: الرجل يخيل إليه أن يجد الشيء في الصلاة؟ قال: "لا ينصرف حتى سمع صوتا، أو يجد ريحا".‏ البخاري (137)‏، ومسلم (361)‏.‏
hadiths.text: It is originally from the Sahihain of Bukhari and Muslim as the Hadith narrated by ‘Abdullah bin Zaid.
hadiths.summary: It is originally from the Sahihain of Bukhari and Muslim as the Hadith narrated by ‘Abdullah bin Zaid.

hadiths.arabic: وَلِمُسْلِمٍ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ نَحْوُهُ.‏
hadiths.text: And Muslim reported by Abu Huraira likewise.
hadiths.summary: And Muslim reported by Abu Huraira likewise.

hadiths.arabic: وَلِلْحَاكِمِ.‏ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ مَرْفُوعًا: { إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ, فَقَالَ: إِنَّكَ أَحْدَثْتَ, فَلْيَقُلْ: كَذَبْتَ }
hadiths.narrator: And Abu Sa’id narrated in Marfu’ Hadith:
hadiths.text: “If Satan comes to one of you and says: ‘You have nullified your ablution (by releasing air)’, let him say: ‘You have lied.” .
hadiths.summary: If Satan comes to one of you and says: ‘You have nullified your ablution (by releasing air)’, let him say: ‘You have lied.

hadiths.arabic: وَأَخْرَجَهُ اِبْنُ حِبَّانَ بِلَفْظِ: { فَلْيَقُلْ فِي نَفْسِهِ }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه الحاكم (134)‏، وابن حبان (2666)‏، وتمامه عندهما: "حتى يسمع صوتا بأذنه، أو يجد ريحا بأنفه".‏
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Hibban also reported the above Hadith with the version:
hadiths.text: “Let him say in his heart...”
hadiths.summary: “Let him say in his heart...”

hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-إِذَا دَخَلَ اَلْخَلَاءَ وَضَعَ خَاتَمَهُ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلْأَرْبَعَةُ, وَهُوَ مَعْلُول ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- منكر .‏ رواه أبو داود (19)‏، والترمذي (1746)‏، والنسائي (1/178)‏، وابن ماجه (303)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas bin Malik (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used to remove his ring when entering the lavatory. .
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used to remove his ring when entering the lavatory. .

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-إِذَا دَخَلَ اَلْخَلَاءَ قَالَ: 
"اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ اَلْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ" }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلسَّبْعَة ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (142)‏، ومسلم (375)‏، وأبو داود (4)‏، والترمذي (5)‏، والنسائي (10)‏، وابن ماجه (296)‏، أحمد (3/99 و 101 و 282)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas (rad):
hadiths.text:
The  Prophet (ﷺ) on entering the lavatory used to say: 

“O Allah, I seek refuge with You from devils – males and females (or all offensive and wicked things, evil deeds and evil spirits, etc.)”
hadiths.summary: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from devils – males and females (or all offensive and wicked things, evil deeds and evil spirits, etc.)

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَدْخُلُ اَلْخَلَاءَ, فَأَحْمِلُ أَنَا وَغُلَامٌ نَحْوِي إِدَاوَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ وَعَنَزَةً, فَيَسْتَنْجِي بِالْمَاءِ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (150)‏، ومسلم (271)‏، (70)‏ واللفظ لمسلم.‏ والعنزة: رميح بين العصا والرمح، فيه زج.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas (rad):
hadiths.text: Whenever Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) went to the privy, a servant and I used to carry a skin water container and a spear, and he would cleanse himself with the water. .
hadiths.summary: Whenever Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) went to the privy, a servant and I used to carry a skin water container and a spear, and he would cleanse himself with the water. .

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { قَالَ لِي اَلنَّبِيُّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-
"خُذِ اَلْإِدَاوَةَ".‏ فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى تَوَارَى عَنِّي, فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (363)‏، ومسلم (274)‏ (77)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu’ba (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) told me, “Take the skin water”, he then went forward till he disappeared from me and relieved himself
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) told me, “Take the skin water”, he then went forward till he disappeared from me and relieved himself

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ اِتَّقُوا اَللَّاعِنِينَ: اَلَّذِي يَتَخَلَّى فِي طَرِيقِ اَلنَّاسِ, أَوْ فِي ظِلِّهِمْ }  رَوَاهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (269)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “Safeguard yourselves from the two matters which cause accursing that befalls the one who relieves himself on people’s path-ways and under the shades.” .
hadiths.summary: Safeguard yourselves from the two matters which cause accursing that befalls the one who relieves himself on people’s path-ways and under the shades.

hadiths.arabic: زَادَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ, عَنْ مُعَاذٍ: { وَالْمَوَارِدَ }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ أي بلفظ: "والموارد" وباقيه صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (26)‏ ولفظه: "اتقوا الملاعن الثلاث: البراز في الموارد، وقارعة الطريق، والظل".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Mu’adh (rad):
hadiths.text: He said: “Guard against the three things which cause curse (i.e.) defecating at the watering places, on the roadbeds and in the shades.”
hadiths.summary: Guard against the three things which cause curse (i.e.) defecating at the watering places, on the roadbeds and in the shades.

hadiths.arabic: وَلِأَحْمَدَ; عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: { أَوْ نَقْعِ مَاءٍ }  وَفِيهِمَا ضَعْف ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أحمد (2715)‏.‏
hadiths.text: Ahmad reported from Ibn Abbas (rad) that defecation is prohibited also at the place where water collects. .
hadiths.summary: Ahmad reported from Ibn Abbas (rad) that defecation is prohibited also at the place where water collects. .

hadiths.arabic: وَأَخْرَجَ اَلطَّبَرَانِيُّ اَلنَّهْيَ عَن ْ  1‏ تَحْتِ اَلْأَشْجَارِ اَلْمُثْمِرَةِ, وَضَفَّةِ اَلنَّهْرِ الْجَارِي.‏ مِنْ حَدِيثِ اِبْنِ عُمَرَ بِسَنَدٍ ضَعِيف ٍ  2‏ .‏‏1 ‏- أي: التخلي.‏‏2 ‏- منكر.‏ رواه الطبراني بتمامه في "الأوسط" كما في مجمع البحرين (349)‏، وفي "الكبير" الشطر الأخير منه كما في "مجمع الزوائد" (104)‏.‏
hadiths.text: At-Tabarani also narrated on the authority of Ibn ‘Umar (with a weak chain of narrators), the prohibition of relieving oneself under fruit trees and beside the bank of a flowing river.
hadiths.summary: At-Tabarani also narrated on the authority of Ibn ‘Umar (with a weak chain of narrators), the prohibition of relieving oneself under fruit trees and beside the bank of a flowing river.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ جَابِرٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ إِذَا تَغَوَّطَ اَلرَّجُلَانِ فَلْيَتَوَارَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَنْ صَاحِبِهِ, وَلَا يَتَحَدَّثَا.‏ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ يَمْقُتُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ }  رَوَاهُ .‏  1‏ وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ اَلسَّكَنِ, وَابْنُ اَلْقَطَّانِ, وَهُوَ مَعْلُول ٌ  2‏ .‏‏1 ‏- كذا بالأصل دون ذكر من أخرجه، ولم أجده من حديث جابر، وهو عند أحمد وأبي داود من حديث أبي سعيد.‏‏2 ‏- ضعيف.‏ وانظر الأصل.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Jabir (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “When two people go together to relieve themselves they should disappear from each other and do not talk, for Allah detests that”. .
hadiths.summary: When two people go together to relieve themselves they should disappear from each other and do not talk, for Allah detests that

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ لَا يُمْسِكَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ ذَكَرَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ, وَهُوَ يَبُولُ, وَلَا يَتَمَسَّحْ مِنْ اَلْخَلَاءِ بِيَمِينِهِ, وَلَا يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي اَلْإِنَاءِ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ, وَاللَّفْظُ لِمُسْلِم ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (153)‏، ومسلم (267)‏ (63)‏ .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Qatada (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “Nobody should touch his pennies with his right hand when urinating, and should not clean himself (from defecation or urine) using his right hand and should not breathe in the utensil (he is drinking from).” .
hadiths.summary: Nobody should touch his pennies with his right hand when urinating, and should not clean himself (from defecation or urine) using his right hand and should not breathe in the utensil (he is drinking from).

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْ سَلْمَانَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { لَقَدْ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-
"أَنْ نَسْتَقْبِلَ اَلْقِبْلَةَ بِغَائِطٍ أَوْ بَوْلٍ, أَوْ أَنْ نَسْتَنْجِيَ بِالْيَمِينِ, أَوْ أَنْ نَسْتَنْجِيَ بِأَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلَاثَةِ أَحْجَارٍ, أَوْ أَنْ نَسْتَنْجِيَ بِرَجِيعٍ أَوْ عَظْمٍ" }  رَوَاهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (262)‏ قيل لسلمان: قد علمكم نبيكم صلى الله عليه وسلم كل شيء حتى الخراءة.‏ قال: أجل.‏ لقد نهانا.‏.‏.‏ الحديث.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Salman (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to face the Qiblah when defecating or urinating, or to clean ourselves using the right hand, or to clean ourselves with less than three stones, or to clean ourselves with dung or a bone .
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to face the Qiblah when defecating or urinating, or to clean ourselves using the right hand, or to clean ourselves with less than three stones, or to clean ourselves with dung or a bone .

hadiths.arabic: وَلِلسَّبْعَةِ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- { لَا تَسْتَقْبِلُوا اَلْقِبْلَةَ بِغَائِطٍ وَلَا بَوْلٍ, وَلَكِنْ شَرِّقُوا أَوْ غَرِّبُوا }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (144 و 394)‏، ومسلم (264)‏، وأبو داود (9)‏، والنسائي (12‏-23)‏، الترمذي (8)‏، وابن ماجه (318)‏، وأحمد (5 /414 و 416 و 417 و 421)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Ayub (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) “Neither face nor turn your back to the Qiblah while defecating or urinating, but turn towards the east or the west”.
hadiths.summary: Neither face nor turn your back to the Qiblah while defecating or urinating, but turn towards the east or the west

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا; أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-قَالَ: { مَنْ أَتَى اَلْغَائِطَ فَلْيَسْتَتِرْ }  رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُد َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ ووهم الحافظ في نسبته لعائشة رضي الله عنها، وإنما الحديث لأبي هريرة عند أبي داود (35)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “If anyone goes to relive himself, he should conceal himself”. .
hadiths.summary: If anyone goes to relive himself, he should conceal himself

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْهَا; { أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ اَلْغَائِطِ قَالَ: 
"غُفْرَانَكَ" }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلْخَمْسَةُ.‏ وَصَحَّحَهُ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ, وَالْحَاكِم ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- حسن.‏ رواه أبو داود (30)‏، والترمذي (7)‏، وابن ماجه (300)‏، والنسائي في "عمل اليوم والليلة" (79)‏، وأحمد (655)‏، وابن حبان (1444)‏، والحاكم (185)‏، من حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text: When the Prophet (ﷺ) came out of the privy, he used to say, “Ghufranaka (O Allah! Grant me Your forgiveness)”. .
hadiths.summary: Ghufranaka (O Allah! Grant me Your forgiveness)

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { أَتَى اَلنَّبِيُّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-اَلْغَائِطَ, فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ آتِيَهُ بِثَلَاثَةِ أَحْجَارٍ, فَوَجَدْتُ حَجَرَيْنِ, وَلَمْ أَجِدْ ثَالِثًا.‏ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِرَوْثَةٍ.‏ فَأَخَذَهُمَا وَأَلْقَى اَلرَّوْثَةَ, وَقَالَ: 
"هَذَا رِكْسٌ" }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلْبُخَارِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (156)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Ibn Mas’ud (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and asked me to bring three stones. I found two stones and searched for the third but could not find it. So I took a dried piece of dung and brought it to him. He took the two stones and threw away the dung and said, “This is a filthy thing”.
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and asked me to bring three stones. I found two stones and searched for the third but could not find it. So I took a dried piece of dung and brought it to him. He took the two stones and threw away the dung and said, “This is a filthy thing”.

hadiths.arabic: زَادَ أَحْمَدُ, وَاَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ: { ائْتِنِي بِغَيْرِهَا }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- رواه أحمد (1 /450)‏، والدارقطني (1 /55)‏ واللفظ للدارقطني، وأما لفظ أحمد، فهو: "ائتني بحجر".‏ وهي زيادة صحيحة.‏
hadiths.narrator: And in the version of Ahmad and Ad-Daraqutni it is added:
hadiths.text: “Bring me more (something other than dung)”].
hadiths.summary: Bring me more (something other than dung)

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- { أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-نَهَى "أَنْ يُسْتَنْجَى بِعَظْمٍ, أَوْ رَوْثٍ" وَقَالَ: "إِنَّهُمَا لَا يُطَهِّرَانِ" }  رَوَاهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ وَصَحَّحَه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه الدارقطني (1 /56/9)‏ وقال: إسناد صحيح.‏ وفي "الأصل" رد على تعليل ابن عدي للحديث.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to use a bone or dung for cleaning and said, “These two things do not purify”. .
hadiths.summary: These two things do not purify

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ اِسْتَنْزِهُوا مِنْ اَلْبَوْلِ, فَإِنَّ عَامَّةَ عَذَابِ اَلْقَبْرِ مِنْهُ }  رَوَاهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه الدارقطني (128 /7)‏، وله ما يشهد له .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “Beware of (smearing yourselves with) urine, because it is the main cause of punishment in the grave”.
hadiths.summary: Beware of (smearing yourselves with) urine, because it is the main cause of punishment in the grave

hadiths.arabic: وَلِلْحَاكِمِ: { أَكْثَرُ عَذَابِ اَلْقَبْرِ مِنْ اَلْبَوْلِ }  وَهُوَ صَحِيحُ اَلْإِسْنَاد ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه الحاكم (183)‏ وقال: "صحيح على شرط الشيخين، ولا أعرف له علة، ولم يخرجاه".‏ وقال الذهبي: "وله شاهد".‏
hadiths.narrator: and Al-Hakim reported that:
hadiths.text: “Urination is the main cause of punishment in the grave”. .
hadiths.summary: Urination is the main cause of punishment in the grave

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْ سُرَاقَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { عَلَّمْنَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-فِي اَلْخَلَاءِ: 
" أَنَّ نَقْعُدَ عَلَى اَلْيُسْرَى, وَنَنْصِبَ اَلْيُمْنَى" }  رَوَاهُ اَلْبَيْهَقِيُّ بِسَنَدٍ ضَعِيف ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه البيهقي (1/96)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Suraqa bin Malik (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) educated us about lavatory (manners) that we should sit on our left foot and keep erect our right foot. .
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) educated us about lavatory (manners) that we should sit on our left foot and keep erect our right foot. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يَزْدَادَ, عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ إِذَا بَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَنْثُرْ ذَكَرَهُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ }  رَوَاهُ اِبْنُ مَاجَه بِسَنَدٍ ضَعِيف ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه ابن ماجه (326)‏ .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Iesa bin Yazdad from his father (ra):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “When one of you passes urine, he should empty his penis three times”. .
hadiths.summary: When one of you passes urine, he should empty his penis three times

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنِ اِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا; { أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-سَأَلَ أَهْلَ قُبَاءٍ, فَقَالُوا: إِنَّا نُتْبِعُ اَلْحِجَارَةَ اَلْمَاءَ }  رَوَاهُ اَلْبَزَّارُ بِسَنَدٍ ضَعِيف ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ لجمعه بين الحجارة والماء، ورواه البزار (227/كشف الأستار)‏ .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Ibn ‘Abbas (ﷺ):
hadiths.text: The Prophet  (ﷺ) asked the residents of Quba that what had earned them the Praise of Allah and they replied, “We use water after (cleaning ourselves with) stones.”
hadiths.summary: We use water after (cleaning ourselves with) stones.

hadiths.arabic: وَأَصْلُهُ فِي أَبِي دَاوُدَ, وَاَلتِّرْمِذِيّ وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ خُزَيْمَةَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- بِدُونِ ذِكْرِ اَلْحِجَارَة ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (44)‏، والترمذي (3100)‏ عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي صلى ال��ه عليه وسلم قال: نزلت هذه الآية في أهل قباء: فيه رجال يحبون أن يتطهروا قال: كانوا يستنجون بالماء، فنزلت فيهم هذه الآية.‏ قلت: وهو وإن كان ضعيف السند إلا أن له شواهد يصح بها، وقد ذكرتها في "الأصل".‏
hadiths.text: and its Asl (original source) is in Abu Da’ud and At-Tirmidhi and Ibn Khuzaima graded it Sahih (sound) through Abu Huraira (rad) without mentioning the “stones”.]
hadiths.summary: and its Asl (original source) is in Abu Da’ud and At-Tirmidhi and Ibn Khuzaima graded it Sahih (sound) through Abu Huraira (rad) without mentioning the “stones”.]

hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ اَلْخُدْرِيِّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ اَلْمَاءُ مِنْ اَلْمَاءِ }  رَوَاهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (343)‏، عن أبي سعيد الخدري قال: خرجت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يوم الاثنين إلى قباء، حتى إذا كنا في بني سالم، وقف رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم على باب عتبان.‏ فصرخ به، فخرج يجر إزاره، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "أعجلنا الرجل" فقال عتبان: يا رسول الله.‏ أرأيت الرجل يعجل عن امرأته ولم يمن ماذا عليه ؟ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إنما…" الحديث .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al-Khudri (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Mesenger (ﷺ) said: “The water (of the ghusl) is due to the water (of sexual emission)”.
hadiths.summary: The water (of the ghusl) is due to the water (of sexual emission)

hadiths.arabic: وَأَصْلُهُ فِي اَلْبُخَارِيّ ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- البخاري.‏ ( 180 )‏، ولفظه: "إذا أعجلت ‏-أو قحطت‏- فعليك الوضوء" وهو رواية لمسلم.‏
hadiths.text: and its Asl (origin) is in Al-Bukhari.
hadiths.summary: and its Asl (origin) is in Al-Bukhari.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ إِذَا جَلَسَ بَيْنَ شُعَبِهَا اَلْأَرْبَعِ, ثُمَّ جَهَدَهَا, فَقَدْ وَجَبَ اَلْغُسْلُ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (291)‏، ومسلم (348)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said that, “If one of you sits between her legs (of a woman) and penetrates her, Ghusl (bath) is obligatory.” .
hadiths.summary: If one of you sits between her legs (of a woman) and penetrates her, Ghusl (bath) is obligatory.

hadiths.arabic:
زَادَ مُسْلِمٌ: 
"وَإِنْ لَمْ يُنْزِلْ "  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- وهي صحيحة أيضا.‏
hadiths.narrator: And Muslim added:
hadiths.text: “Even if he does not ejaculate”.
hadiths.summary: “Even if he does not ejaculate”.

hadiths.arabic:
] وَعَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ; أَنَّ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ ‏-وَهِيَ اِمْرَأَةُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ‏- قَالَتْ: { يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ! إِنَّ اَللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحِي مِنْ اَلْحَقِّ, فَهَلْ عَلَى اَلْمَرْأَةِ اَلْغُسْلُ إِذَا اِحْتَلَمَتْ? قَالَ: 
"نَعَمْ.‏ إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَاءَ" }  اَلْحَدِيثَ.‏ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ [ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (282)‏، ومسلم (313)‏، وزاد مسلم: "فقالت أم سلمة: يا رسول الله! وتحتلم المرأة؟ فقال: تربت يداك! فبم يشبهها ولدها".‏ وزاد في رواية أخرى: "قالت: قلت: فضحت النساء".‏ ملاحظة: هذا الحديث لا يوجد في الأصل وأشار ناسخ "أ" إلى أنه من نسخة، مع العلم بأن الحديث ذكر في متن "أ"، وليس بالهامش.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Umm Salam (rad):
hadiths.text: Umm Sulaim, the wife Abu Talha said, “O Allah’s Messenger! Allah is not ashamed of the truth. Is a Ghusl (bath) compulsory for a woman when she has a sexual dream?” He (ﷺ) replied, “Yes! When she sees signs of liquid” .
hadiths.summary: O Allah’s Messenger! Allah is not ashamed of the truth. Is a Ghusl (bath) compulsory for a woman when she has a sexual dream?

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَنَسِ]بْنِ مَالِكٍ] ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-‏-فِي اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى فِي مَنَامِهَا مَا يَرَى اَلرَّجُلُ‏- قَالَ: "تَغْتَسِلُ" }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- عزوه للمتفق عليه وهم الحافظ ‏-رحمه الله‏- إذا الحديث لم يروه البخاري.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said about the precept of a woman having ejaculation during sleep like a man, “She should take a Ghusl (bath)”.
hadiths.summary: She should take a Ghusl (bath)

hadiths.arabic: زَادَ مُسْلِمٌ: فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْم ٍ  1‏ { وَهَلْ يَكُونُ هَذَا? قَالَ: "نَعَمْ فَمِنْ أَيْنَ يَكُونُ اَلشَّبَهُ? }   2‏ .‏‏1 ‏- تحرف في "الأصلين" إلى "أم سلمة" وما أثبته من صحيح مسلم.‏‏2 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم ( 311 )‏ وهو بتمامه: عن أنس بن مالك؛ أن أم سليم سألت نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: عن المرأة ترى في منامها ما يرى الرجل؟ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إذا رأت ذلك المرأة فلتغتسل" فقالت أم سليم: واستحييت من ذلك.‏ قالت: وهل يكون هذا؟ فقال نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "نعم.‏ فمن أين يكون الشبه.‏ إن ماء الرجل غليظ أبيض.‏ وماء المرأة رقيق أصفر.‏ فمن أيهما علا أو سبق يكون منه الشبه".‏
hadiths.narrator: Added Muslim:
hadiths.text: Umm Salama said, “Does this happen (to a woman)?” He (ﷺ) said: “Yes, otherwise where does the resemblance (of a child to its mother) come from?”
hadiths.summary: Does this happen (to a woman)?

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: { كَانَ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ: مِنْ اَلْجَنَابَةِ, وَيَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ, وَمِنْ اَلْحِجَامَةِ, وَمِنْ غُسْلِ اَلْمَيِّتِ }  رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ خُزَيْمَة َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أبو داود (348)‏، وابن خزيمة (256)‏، والحديث عند أبي داود من فعله، وعند ابن خزيمة من قوله!! .‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a bath from four things; after sexual intercourse, on Fridays, after extracting blood from his body and after washing a dead body.
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a bath from four things; after sexual intercourse, on Fridays, after extracting blood from his body and after washing a dead body.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- { ‏-فِي قِصَّةِ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ أُثَالٍ, عِنْدَمَا أَسْلَم‏- وَأَمَرَهُ اَلنَّبِيُّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ }  رَوَاهُ عَبْدُ اَلرَّزَّاق ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ وهو في "مصنف عبد الرازق" (6/9‏-10/9834)‏ وفيه: "فأمره أن يغتسل فاغتسل".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Huraira (rad) regarding the story of Thumama bin Uthal when he embraced Islam:
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to take a bath.
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to take a bath.

hadiths.arabic: وَأَصْلُهُ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- البخاري (4372)‏، ومسلم (1764)‏ من حديث أبي هريرة أيضا، وفيه: "فانطلق ‏-أي: ثمامة‏- إلى نخل قريب من المسجد، فاغتسل".‏
hadiths.text: and its origin is in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hadiths.summary: and its origin is in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-قَالَ: { غُسْلُ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ }  أَخْرَجَهُ اَلسَّبْعَة ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (879)‏، ومسلم (846)‏، وأبو داود (341)‏، والنسائي (3/92)‏، وابن ماجه (1089)‏، وأحمد (3 /60)‏.‏ "تنبيه": وهم الحافظ رحمه الله في عزوه الحديث للترمذي.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al-Khudri (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “Taking a bath on Friday is a must for every adult”. .
hadiths.summary: Taking a bath on Friday is a must for every adult

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ سَمُرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَبِهَا وَنِعْمَتْ, وَمَنْ اِغْتَسَلَ فَالْغُسْلُ أَفْضَلُ }  رَوَاهُ اَلْخَمْسَةُ, وَحَسَّنَهُ اَلتِّرْمِذِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- حسن.‏ رواه أبو داود (354)‏، والترمذي (497)‏، والنسائي (3/94)‏، وأحمد (51 و 15 و 22)‏، وقال الترمذي: "حديث حسن".‏ قلت: وعزو الحافظ الحديث للخمسة وهم منه رحمه الله إذ الحديث ليس عند ابن ماجه، عن سمرة، وإنما عنده عن أنس.‏ انظر "الجمعة وفضلها" لأبي بكر المروزي (31 بتحقيقي)‏ والحافظ نفسه عزاه في "الفتح" لأصحاب السنن الثلاثة.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Sumara (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “Whoever performs ablution on Friday has done a good thing and he who takes bath, taking bath is better  (for him).”
hadiths.summary: Whoever performs ablution on Friday has done a good thing and he who takes bath, taking bath is better (for him).

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يُقْرِئُنَا اَلْقُرْآنَ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ جُنُبًا }  رَوَاهُ اَلْخَمْسَةُ, وَهَذَا لَفْظُ اَلتِّرْمِذِيِّ وَحَسَّنَةُ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ حِبَّان َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أبو داود (229)‏، والنسائي (144)‏، والترمذي (146)‏، ابن ماجه (594)‏، وأحمد (1/83)‏، وابن حبان (799)‏.‏ ولبعضهم ألفاظ أخر.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Ali (rad):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach us the Qur’an except when he was in a state of sexual impurity. .
hadiths.summary: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach us the Qur’an except when he was in a state of sexual impurity. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ اَلْخُدْرِيِّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَهْلَهُ, ثُمَّ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَعُودَ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ بَيْنَهُمَا وُضُوءًا }  رَوَاهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (308)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al-Khudri (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: “If one of you has sexual intercourse with his wife and wishes to repeat he should perform ablution between them” .
hadiths.summary: If one of you has sexual intercourse with his wife and wishes to repeat he should perform ablution between them

hadiths.arabic: زَادَ اَلْحَاكِمُ: { فَإِنَّهُ أَنْشَطُ لِلْعَوْدِ }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- مستدرك الحاكم (152)‏ وهي زيادة صحيحة أيضا.‏
hadiths.narrator: A-Hakim added:
hadiths.text: “Ablution makes one active for repeating (the sexual act).”
hadiths.summary: Ablution makes one active for repeating (the sexual act).

hadiths.arabic: وَلِلْأَرْبَعَةِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-يَنَامُ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ, مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَمَسَّ مَاءً }  وَهُوَ مَعْلُول ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (228)‏ والنسائي في "الكبرى"، والترمذي (118 و 119)‏، وابن ماجه (583)‏.‏ وأما عن تعليل من أعله فتفصيل ذلك في "الأصل" إذ ليست كل علة تقدح في صحة الحديث.‏ وانظر أيضا "ناسخ الحديث ومنسوخه" لابن شاهين (129)‏ بتحقيقي.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used to sleep in the state of sexual impurity without touching water. .
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) used to sleep in the state of sexual impurity without touching water. .

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: { كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-إِذَا اِغْتَسَلَ مِنْ اَلْجَنَابَةِ يَبْدَأُ فَيَغْسِلُ يَدَيْهِ, ثُمَّ يُفْرِغُ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ, فَيَغْسِلُ فَرْجَهُ, ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ, ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ اَلْمَاءَ, فَيُدْخِلُ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي أُصُولِ اَلشَّعْرِ, ثُمَّ حَفَنَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلَاثَ حَفَنَاتٍ, ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَى سَائِرِ جَسَدِهِ, ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ, وَاللَّفْظُ لِمُسْلِم ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (248)‏، ومسلم (316)‏، وبما أن المؤلف ساق لفظ مسلم فعنده بعد قول: "أصول الشعر" إضافة وهي قولها: "حتى إذا رأى أن قد استبرأ".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated ‘Aisha (rad):
hadiths.text: Whenever Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) took Ghusl (bath) after sexual intercourse, he would begin by washing his hands, then pour water with his right hand on his left hand and wash his sexual organ. He would then perform ablution, then take some water and run his fingers through the roots of the hair. Then he would pour three handfuls on his head, then pour water over the rest of his body and subsequently wash his feet.
hadiths.summary: Whenever Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) took Ghusl (bath) after sexual intercourse, he would begin by washing his hands, then pour water with his right hand on his left hand and wash his sexual organ. He would then perform ablution, then take some water and run his fingers through the roots of the hair. Then he would pour three handfuls on his head, then pour water over the rest of his body and subsequently wash his feet.

hadiths.arabic: وَلَهُمَا فِي حَدِيثِ مَيْمُونَةَ: { ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ, فَغَسَلَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ, ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِهَا اَلْأَرْضَ }
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Maimuma (rad):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) poured water over his private parts and washed them with his left hand. He then struck his hand against the earth.
hadiths.summary: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) poured water over his private parts and washed them with his left hand. He then struck his hand against the earth.

hadiths.arabic: وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: { فَمَسَحَهَا بِالتُّرَابِ }
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Maimuna (Radhi Allahu Anhu):
hadiths.text: "And he wiped it with earth".
hadiths.summary: "And he wiped it with earth".

hadiths.arabic: وَفِي آخِرِهِ: { ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ }  فَرَدَّهُ, وَفِيهِ: { وَجَعَلَ يَنْفُضُ الْمَاءَ بِيَدِهِ }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري، (249)‏، وانظر أطرافه، ومسلم (317)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Maimuna (Radhi Allahu Anhu):
hadiths.text: And in the last of this version: “I handed him a piece of cloth, but he did not take it... He started shaking the water off his hand.”
hadiths.summary: I handed him a piece of cloth, but he did not take it... He started shaking the water off his hand.

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: { قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ إِنِّي اِمْرَأَةٌ أَشُدُّ شَعْرَ رَأْسِي, أَفَأَنْقُضُهُ لِغُسْلِ اَلْجَنَابَةِ? وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: وَالْحَيْضَةِ? فَقَالَ: 
"لَا, إِنَّمَا يَكْفِيكِ أَنْ تَحْثِي عَلَى رَأْسِكِ ثَلَاثَ حَثَيَاتٍ" }  رَوَاهُ مُسْلِم ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (330)‏، وزاد: "ثم تفيضين عليك الماء فتطهرين".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Umm Salamah (RAA):
hadiths.text:
I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who keeps her hair closely plaited. Do I have to undo them for Ghusl after sexual intercourse?" In another narration, "and after the end of menses?" He replied (ﷺ), "No, is it enough for you to throw three handfuls of water over your head."
Related by Muslim.
hadiths.summary: O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who keeps her hair closely plaited. Do I have to undo them for Ghusl after sexual intercourse?

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ إِنِّي لَا أُحِلُّ اَلْمَسْجِدَ لِحَائِضٍ وَلَا جُنُبٌ }  رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ خُزَيْمَة َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أبو داود (232)‏، وابن خزيمة (1327)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated `A'ishah (RAA):
hadiths.text:
Allah's messenger (ﷺ) said: "It is not permitted for a menstruating woman or one who is junub (sexually impure) to stay in the mosque."
Related by Abu Dawud and Ibn Khuzaimah graded it as Sahih
hadiths.summary: It is not permitted for a menstruating woman or one who is junub (sexually impure) to stay in the mosque.

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْهَا قَالَتْ: { كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ, تَخْتَلِفُ أَيْدِينَا فِيهِ مِنَ اَلْجَنَابَةِ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْه ِ  1‏ .‏ 
زَادَ اِبْنُ حِبَّانَ: وَتَلْتَقِ ي  2‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (261)‏، ومسلم (321)‏ (45)‏، وليس عند البخاري لفظه: "من الجنابة ".‏
‏2 ‏- ابن حبان برقم (1111)‏ وسندها صحيح، إلا أن الحافظ في "الفتح" (1/373)‏ مال إلى أنها مدرجة.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated `A'ishah (RAA):
hadiths.text:
I and Allah's Messenger (Peace be upon him) took a Ghusl (bath) due to sexual impurity from the same vessel and our hands alternated into it.


Ibn Hibban added "and (our hands) met."
hadiths.summary: I and Allah's Messenger (Peace be upon him) took a Ghusl (bath) due to sexual impurity from the same vessel and our hands alternated into it. Ibn Hibban added "and (our hands) met."

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ إِنَّ تَحْتَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ جَنَابَةً, فَاغْسِلُوا اَلشَّعْرَ, وَأَنْقُوا اَلْبَشَرَ }  رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ, وَاَلتِّرْمِذِيُّ وَضَعَّفَاه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- منكر.‏ رواه أبو داود (248)‏، والترمذي (106)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Hurairah (RAA):
hadiths.text:
Allah's Messenger (Peace be upon him) said: "There is Janabah (trace of sexual impurity) under every hair, so wash your hair and cleanse the skin."
Abu Dawud and at-Tirmidhi transmitted it but they declared it to be weak.
hadiths.summary: There is Janabah (trace of sexual impurity) under every hair, so wash your hair and cleanse the skin.

hadiths.arabic: وَلِأَحْمَدَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ نَحْوُهُ, وَفِيهِ رَاوٍ مَجْهُول ٌ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أحمد (654)‏.‏
hadiths.text: Ahmad transmitted a similar narration to the above, on the authority of `A'ishah (RAA), but this version has an unknown transmitter.
hadiths.summary: Ahmad transmitted a similar narration to the above, on the authority of `A'ishah (RAA), but this version has an unknown transmitter.

hadiths.arabic: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا; أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-قَالَ: { أُعْطِيتُ خَمْسًا لَمْ يُعْطَهُنَّ أَحَدٌ قَبْلِي: نُصِرْتُ بِالرُّعْبِ مَسِيرَةَ شَهْرٍ, وَجُعِلَتْ لِي اَلْأَرْضُ مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا, فَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَتْهُ اَلصَّلَاةُ فَلْيُصَلِّ }  وَذَكَرَ اَلْحَدِيث َ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (335)‏، ومسلم (521)‏ وتمامه: "وأحلت لي المغانم ولم تحل لأحد قبلي، وأعطيت الشفاعة، وكان النبي يبعث إلى قومه خاصة، وبعثت إلى الناس عامة" والسياق للبخاري.‏ تنبيه: هكذا الحديث في الأصل دون ذكر من أخرجه وكتب بالهامش: لعله سقط "متفق عليه".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah (RAA):
hadiths.text: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "I have been given five things which were not given to anyone else before me. Allah made me victorious by awe (of frightening my enemies) for a distance of one month's journey. The earth has been made for me (and my followers) a place for praying and something with which to perform Tayammum (to purify oneself for prayer). Therefore, anyone (of my followers) can pray (anywhere) and at any time that the Salat (prayer) is due."
hadiths.summary: I have been given five things which were not given to anyone else before me. Allah made me victorious by awe (of frightening my enemies) for a distance of one month's journey. The earth has been made for me (and my followers) a place for praying and something with which to perform Tayammum (to purify oneself for prayer). Therefore, anyone (of my followers) can pray (anywhere) and at any time that the Salat (prayer) is due.

hadiths.arabic: وَفِي حَدِيثِ حُذَيْفَةَ عِنْدَ مُسْلِمٍ: { وَجُعِلَتْ تُرْبَتُهَا لَنَا طَهُورًا, إِذَا لَمْ نَجِدِ اَلْمَاءَ }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه مسلم (522)‏، وأوله: "فضلنا على الناس بثلاث: جعلت صفوفنا كصفوف الملائكة، وجعلت.‏.‏.‏" الحديث.‏
hadiths.narrator: In another narration by Hudhaifah (RAA):
hadiths.text:
"And the soil of the earth had been made for us as a means with which to purify ourselves (for prayer), when we cannot find water."
Related by Muslim.
hadiths.summary: And the soil of the earth had been made for us as a means with which to purify ourselves (for prayer), when we cannot find water.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- عِنْدَ أَحْمَدَ: { وَجُعِلَ اَلتُّرَابُ لِي طَهُورًا }   1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- حسن.‏ رواه أحمد (763)‏ وتمام لفظه: "أعطيت ما لم يعط أحد من الأنبياء" فقلنا: يا رسول الله! ما هو؟ قال: "نصرت بالرعب، وأعطيت مفاتيح الأرض، وسميت: أحمد، وجعل التراب لي طهورا، وجعلت أمتي خير الأمم".‏
hadiths.narrator: Ahmad transmitted on the authority of `Ali (RAA):
hadiths.text: "The earth (dust) has been made for me as a means for purification."
hadiths.summary: The earth (dust) has been made for me as a means for purification.

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: { بَعَثَنِي اَلنَّبِيُّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-فِي حَاجَةٍ, فَأَجْنَبْتُ, فَلَمْ أَجِدِ اَلْمَاءَ, فَتَمَرَّغْتُ فِي اَلصَّعِيدِ كَمَا تَمَرَّغُ اَلدَّابَّةُ, ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ اَلنَّبِيَّ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ, فَقَالَ: 
"إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ أَنْ تَقُولَ بِيَدَيْكَ هَكَذَا" ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِيَدَيْهِ اَلْأَرْضَ ضَرْبَةً وَاحِدَةً, ثُمَّ مَسَحَ اَلشِّمَالَ عَلَى اَلْيَمِينِ, وَظَاهِرَ كَفَّيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ }  مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ, وَاللَّفْظُ لِمُسْلِم ٍ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البخاري (347)‏، ومسلم (368)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated `Ammar bin Yasir (RAA):
hadiths.text:
The Prophet (ﷺ) sent me on some errands and I became junub (sexually impure), and could not find water. I rolled myself in the dirt just as an animal does. I then came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. He said, "This would have been enough for you," and he struck the earth with his hands once, then he wiped the right hand with the left one, and the outside of the palms of his hands and his face.
.
hadiths.summary: This would have been enough for you,

hadiths.arabic: وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لِلْبُخَارِيِّ: وَضَرَبَ بِكَفَّيْهِ اَلْأَرْضَ, وَنَفَخَ فِيهِمَا, ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ وَكَفَّيْه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- البخاري رقم (338)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: In a version by Al-Bukhari, `Ammar said:
hadiths.text: 'He (ﷺ) struck the earth with the palms of his hands, blew in them and wiped his face and hands with them.
hadiths.summary: 'He (ﷺ) struck the earth with the palms of his hands, blew in them and wiped his face and hands with them.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنِ اِبْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ التَّيَمُّمُ ضَرْبَتَانِ ضَرْبَةٌ لِلْوَجْهِ, وَضَرْبَةٌ لِلْيَدَيْنِ إِلَى اَلْمِرْفَقَيْنِ }  رَوَاهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ, وَصَحَّحَ اَلْأَئِمَّةُ وَقْفَه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف جدا.‏ رواه الدارقطني (1806)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Ibn `Umar (RAA):
hadiths.text:
Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: "Tayammum is two strikes: one for the face and one for the hands up to the elbows."
Reported by Ad-Daraqutni
hadiths.summary: Tayammum is two strikes: one for the face and one for the hands up to the elbows.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-{ اَلصَّعِيدُ وُضُوءُ اَلْمُسْلِمِ, وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ اَلْمَاءَ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ, فَإِذَا وَجَدَ اَلْمَاءَ فَلْيَتَّقِ اَللَّهَ, وَلْيُمِسَّهُ بَشَرَتَهُ }  رَوَاهُ اَلْبَزَّارُ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ اَلْقَطَّانِ, ]و] لَكِنْ صَوَّبَ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ إِرْسَالَه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه البزار (310 زوائد)‏ وما بعده يشهد له.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Hurairah (RAA):
hadiths.text: Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: "The soil is a purifier for a Muslim, even if he does not find water for ten years; but if he finds water, he must fear Allah and let it touch his skin."
hadiths.summary: The soil is a purifier for a Muslim, even if he does not find water for ten years; but if he finds water, he must fear Allah and let it touch his skin.

hadiths.arabic: وَلِلتِّرْمِذِيِّ: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ نَحْوُهُ, وَصَحَّحَه ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه الترمذي (124)‏ ولفظه: "إن الصعيد الطيب طهور المسلم، وإن لم يجد الماء عشر سنين، فإذا وجد الماء فليمسه بشرته؛ فإن ذلك خير" وقال: "حديث حسن صحيح".‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Dharr (RAA):
hadiths.text: a similar Hadith transmitted by at-Tirmidhi
hadiths.summary: a similar Hadith transmitted by at-Tirmidhi

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ اَلْخُدْرِيِّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { خَرَجَ رَجُلَانِ فِي سَفَرٍ, فَحَضَرَتْ اَلصَّلَاةَ ‏-وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمَا مَاءٌ‏- فَتَيَمَّمَا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا, فَصَلَّيَا, ثُمَّ وَجَدَا اَلْمَاءَ فِي اَلْوَقْتِ.‏ فَأَعَادَ أَحَدُهُمَا اَلصَّلَاةَ وَالْوُضُوءَ, وَلَمْ يُعِدِ اَلْآخَرُ, ثُمَّ أَتَيَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-فَذَكَرَا ذَلِكَ لَهُ, فَقَالَ لِلَّذِي لَمْ يُعِدْ: "أَصَبْتَ اَلسُّنَّةَ وَأَجْزَأَتْكَ صَلَاتُكَ" وَقَالَ لِلْآخَرِ: "لَكَ اَلْأَجْرُ مَرَّتَيْنِ" }  رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ, ]و] النَّسَائِيّ ُ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (338)‏، والنسائي (113)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RAA):
hadiths.text: Two men set out on a journey and when the time of Salat (prayer) came they had no water. They performed Tayammum with clean earth and prayed. Later on they found water within the time of the prayer.  One of them repeated his prayer with ablution but the other did not repeat. Then they came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and related the matter to him. Addressing himself to the one who did not repeat, he said, "You followed the Sunnah and your (first) prayer was enough for you." He said to the one who performed ablution and repeated: "For you there is a double reward".
hadiths.summary: You followed the Sunnah and your (first) prayer was enough for you.

hadiths.arabic:
وَعَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ﴿ وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ  ﴾ 1‏ قَالَ: 
"إِذَا كَانَتْ بِالرَّجُلِ اَلْجِرَاحَةُ فِي سَبِيلِ اَللَّهِ وَالْقُرُوحُ, فَيُجْنِبُ, فَيَخَافُ أَنْ يَمُوتَ إِنْ اِغْتَسَلَ: تَيَمَّمَ" .‏ رَوَاهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ مَوْقُوفًا, وَرَفَعَهُ اَلْبَزَّارُ, وَصَحَّحَهُ اِبْنُ خُزَيْمَةَ, وَالْحَاكِم ُ  2‏ .‏‏1 ‏- صحيح.‏ رواه أبو داود (338)‏، والنسائي (113)‏.‏‏2 ‏- ضعيف موقوفا، ومرفوعا.‏ والموقوف رواه الدار قطني (177/9)‏.‏ والمرفوع رواه ابن خزيمة (272)‏، والحاكم (165)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Ibn `Abbas (RAA):
hadiths.text:
concerning the verse, “And if you are ill or on a journey...” (an-Nisa': 43). He said, "If a man sustains a wound, which he suffered during Jihad (in the cause of Allah) or ulcers, then he became junub (sexually impure) and is afraid that if he bathes he would die; he may perform ablution with clean earth (Tayammum).
.
hadiths.summary: And if you are ill or on a journey...

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ ‏- رضى الله عنه ‏- قَالَ: { اِنْكَسَرَتْ إِحْدَى زَنْدَيَّ فَسَأَلَتْ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ‏- صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏-فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَمْسَحَ عَلَى اَلْجَبَائِرِ }  رَوَاهُ اِبْنُ مَاجَه بِسَنَدٍ وَاهٍ جِدًّ ا  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- موضوع.‏ رواه ابن ماجه (657)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated `Ali (RAA):
hadiths.text:
One of my forearms was broken. Then I consulted Allah's Messenger (Peace be upon him) and he ordered me to wipe over the bandages.
.
hadiths.summary: One of my forearms was broken. Then I consulted Allah's Messenger (Peace be upon him) and he ordered me to wipe over the bandages. .

hadiths.arabic: { وَعَنْ جَابِرٍ]بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ] رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا فِي اَلرَّجُلِ اَلَّذِي شُجَّ, فَاغْتَسَلَ فَمَاتَ ‏-: "إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيهِ أَنْ يَتَيَمَّمَ, وَيَعْصِبَ عَلَى جُرْحِهِ خِرْقَةً, ثُمَّ يَمْسَحَ عَلَيْهَا وَيَغْسِلَ سَائِرَ جَسَدِهِ" }  رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ بِسَنَدٍ فِيهِ ضَعْفٌ, وَفِيهِ اِخْتِلَافٌ عَلَى رُوَاتِه ِ  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف.‏ رواه أبو داود (336)‏ من حديث جابر، قال: خرجنا في سفر، فأصاب رجلا منا حجر فشجه في رأسه، ثم احتلم، فسأل أصحابه، فقال: هل تجدون لي رخصة في التيمم؟ فقالوا: ما نجد لك رخصة وأنت تقدر على الماء، فاغتسل فمات، فلما قدمنا على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أخبر بذلك، فقال: "قتلوه قتلهم الله، ألا سألوا إذ لم يعلموا، فإنما شفاه العي السؤال، .‏.‏.‏" الحديث.‏ وإطلاق التحسين على الحديث لأن له شواهد كما في "جامع الأصول" (764)‏ فهو من باب الخطأ، إذ الشواهد إنما تشهد للقدر الذي ذكرته فقط هنا، وأما القدر الذي ذكره الحافظ ‏-وهو محل الشاهد‏- فيبقي على ضعفه.‏ والله أعلم.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah (RAA):
hadiths.text: concerning the man who had a head injury, and then he made Ghusl and died: Allah's Messenger Peace be upon him said, "It would have been enough for him to perform Tayammum and wrap it with something and wipe over the wrapping and wash the rest of his body."
hadiths.summary: It would have been enough for him to perform Tayammum and wrap it with something and wipe over the wrapping and wash the rest of his body.

hadiths.arabic: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: { مِنْ اَلسُّنَّةِ أَنْ لَا يُصَلِّيَ اَلرَّجُلُ بِالتَّيَمُّمِ إِلَّا صَلَاةً وَاحِدَةً, ثُمَّ يَتَيَمَّمُ لِلصَّلَاةِ اَلْأُخْرَى }  رَوَاهُ اَلدَّارَقُطْنِيُّ بِإِسْنَادٍ ضَعِيفٍ جِدًّ ا  1‏ .‏‏1 ‏- ضعيف جدا.‏ رواه الدارقطني (185)‏.‏
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Ibn `Abbas (RAA):
hadiths.text: It is from the Sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ) for the man to pray only one prayer with each Tayammum, and then perform Tayammum for the next prayer.
hadiths.summary: It is from the Sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ) for the man to pray only one prayer with each Tayammum, and then perform Tayammum for the next prayer.

hadiths.arabic:
